name: Airy Clean
description: Airy clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.
script:
# Airy Clean
# Airy clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.
# a Drive: 0.5 to 2.8, default 1.1
# b Bright: 0 to 7, default 3.2
# c Level: 0.55 to 1.45, default 1.1

param a = Drive [0.5, 2.8]
param b = Bright [0.0, 7.0]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.22 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5) # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4800; q = 0.65; gain = b # high shelf
stage2: y = softclip(y, 0.75) * c # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9500; resonance = 0.25 # lowpass

name: Plexi Crunch
description: Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.
script:
# Plexi Crunch
# Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 7.5, default 3.6
# b Presence: 2000 to 7000, default 3800
# c Level: 0.38 to 1.15, default 0.72

param a = Drive [1.4, 7.5]
param b = Presence [2000, 7000]
param c = Level [0.38, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.38 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6) # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.7) # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 750; q = 1.05; gain = 5 # peak EQ
stage3: y = softclip(y * 1.2, 1.45) * c # soft clip
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.7; gain = 2.8 # high shelf
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5500; resonance = 0.4 # lowpass

name: Mesa High Gain
description: Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.
script:
# Mesa High Gain
# Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.
# a Gain: 3.5 to 12, default 7.8
# b Tight: 45 to 200, default 85
# c Level: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.42

param a = Gain [3.5, 12.0]
param b = Tight [45, 200]
param c = Level [0.25, 0.9]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 6; hold = 0.03; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = tube(y, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage4: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.55), 0.68)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.58  # lowpass
stage5: y = diode(y, 1.6) * c  # diode clip
ir1: mix = 0.45; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: Top Boost Chime
description: AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.
script:
# Top Boost Chime
# AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6.5, default 2.9
# b Cut: 280 to 1400, default 520
# c Level: 0.45 to 1.25, default 0.92

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Cut [280, 1400]
param c = Level [0.45, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.85) # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 1.15; gain = 4.5 # peak EQ
stage2: y = softclip(y * 1.15, 1.5) * c # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8200; resonance = 0.32 # lowpass

name: Mid Boost OD
description: mid-boost OD: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.
script:
# Mid Boost OD
# mid-boost OD: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 11, default 5.2
# b Tone: 350 to 4500, default 1800
# c Level: 0.28 to 1.15, default 0.7

param a = Drive [1.2, 11.0]
param b = Tone [350, 4500]
param c = Level [0.28, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 720; resonance = 0.28 # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 720; q = 1.65; gain = 6 # peak EQ
stage2: y = diode(y * 1.15, 1.3) * c # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.48 # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 6 # impulse response

name: Transparent Blend
description: Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (transparent OD-style clean blend).
script:
# Transparent Blend
# Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (transparent OD-style clean blend).
# a Drive: 0.8 to 8, default 3
# b Blend: 0.2 to 0.95, default 0.62
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.3, default 0.9

param a = Drive [0.8, 8.0]
param b = Blend [0.2, 0.95]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.3]
stage1: y = x * c # waveshape / mix
bus dirt:
 send: in = 1 # feed this bus from the input
 filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.3 # highpass
 stage2: y = diode(x, a) * c # diode clip
 eq1: type = peak; freq = 1050; q = 0.85; gain = 3.5 # peak EQ
 filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3 # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; dirt = b # mix buses back to the output

name: Filter Dist
description: RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).
script:
# Filter Dist
# RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).
# a Dist: 2 to 12, default 6.5
# b Filter: 300 to 6500, default 1800
# c Level: 0.25 to 1, default 0.58

param a = Dist [2.0, 12.0]
param b = Filter [300, 6500]
param c = Level [0.25, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35 # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.55), 0.55) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6 # lowpass
stage2: y = y * c # waveshape / mix

name: Germanium Fuzz
description: Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).
script:
# Germanium Fuzz
# Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).
# a Fuzz: 3 to 16, default 9
# b Tone: 250 to 4500, default 1400
# c Level: 0.15 to 0.85, default 0.42

param a = Fuzz [3.0, 16.0]
param b = Tone [250, 4500]
param c = Level [0.15, 0.85]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 8; hold = 0.04; range = -80 # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.3 # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x + 0.06, a * 0.4), 0.38) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7 # lowpass
stage2: y = tube(y, 1.4) * c # tube saturation
ir1: mix = 0.35; gain = 8 # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1 # limiter

name: Cyberpunk Drive
description: Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.
script:
# Cyberpunk Drive
# Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.
# a Drive: 1.8 to 9.5, default 4.6
# b Bits: 5 to 12, default 8.5
# c Fold: 0.22 to 0.68, default 0.4
# d Metal: 5 to 26, default 11
# e Tone: 1400 to 7200, default 4200
# f Level: 0.85 to 1.5, default 1.15

param a = Drive [1.8, 9.5]
param b = Bits [5.0, 12.0]
param c = Fold [0.22, 0.68]
param d = Metal [5, 26]
param e = Tone [1400, 7200]
param f = Level [0.85, 1.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 115; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.5)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1350; q = 0.95; gain = 3.2  # peak EQ
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, b)  # bitcrush
stage3: y = fold(y, -c, c)  # wavefold
delay1: time = d; feedback = 0.34; mix = 0.16; damp = 6800  # delay line
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.38  # lowpass
stage4: y = diode(y, 1.32) * f * 1.35  # diode clip

name: Classic Tremolo
description: Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.
script:
# Classic Tremolo
# Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.4
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.5
# c Floor: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Chopper
description: Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).
script:
# Chopper
# Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Depth: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.55
# c Floor: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.25, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.15, 0.55]
osc1: shape = softsquare; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Optical Vibe
description: Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.
script:
# Optical Vibe
# Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.
# a Rate: 0.15 to 6, default 1.1
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.55
# c Drive: 1 to 3, default 1.6

param a = Rate [0.15, 6.0]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Drive [1.0, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0 # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, c) # tube saturation
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)) # waveshape / mix

name: Chorus Delay
description: Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.
script:
# Chorus Delay
# Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.
# a Rate: 0.25 to 3.5, default 1.05
# b Depth: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.32
# c Time: 8 to 32, default 18
# d Mix: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.34

param a = Rate [0.25, 3.5]
param b = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param c = Time [8, 32]
param d = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
osc2: shape = sine; freq = a * 1.31; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.35)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.14; mix = d; damp = 9500  # delay line
stage2: y = softclip(y * (1.0 - b + b * 0.5 * ((0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2))), 1.08)  # soft clip

name: Low Pass Sweep
description: Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.
script:
# Low Pass Sweep
# Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Min: 180 to 800, default 420
# c Depth: 400 to 5000, default 2400
# d Res: 0.4 to 3, default 1.4

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Min [180, 800]
param c = Depth [400, 5000]
param d = Res [0.4, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c; resonance = d  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, 1.08)  # diode clip

name: Bandpass Vocal
description: Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.
script:
# Bandpass Vocal
# Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.
# a Center: 350 to 2800, default 950
# b Width: 100 to 1000, default 380
# c Drive: 0.9 to 2.8, default 1.5

param a = Center [350, 2800]
param b = Width [100, 1000]
param c = Drive [0.9, 2.8]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b  # bandpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Transient Bite
description: Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.
script:
# Transient Bite
# Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# b Attack: 0.001 to 0.015, default 0.003
# c Release: 0.02 to 0.2, default 0.07
# d Amount: 0.25 to 0.95, default 0.65

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.0]
param b = Attack [0.001, 0.015]
param c = Release [0.02, 0.2]
param d = Amount [0.25, 0.95]
env1: type = peak; attack = b; release = c  # envelope follower
stage1: y = softclip(x * (a + env1 * a * d), 1.0)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Metal Gate
description: Tight metal: HPF -> tube cascade -> soft-pre hard knee -> cab LPF (filter after clip).
script:
# Metal Gate
# Tight metal: HPF → tube cascade → soft-pre hard knee → cab LPF, then width.
# a Drive: 4 to 14, default 8.5
# b LowCut: 70 to 350, default 140
# c Level: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.45
# d Width: 0 to 1.2, default 0.55

param a = Drive [4.0, 14.0]
param b = LowCut [70, 350]
param c = Level [0.2, 0.85]
param d = Width [0.0, 1.2]
gate1: threshold = -38; hyst = 8; attack = 0.004; hold = 0.08; release = 0.12; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(tube(y, a * 0.5), 1.1), 0.5)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.6  # lowpass
stage3: y = y * c  # waveshape / mix
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08  # limiter
widen1: width = d  # mono to stereo

name: Vocal Grit
description: Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.
script:
# Vocal Grit
# Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 5.5, default 2.6
# b LowCut: 80 to 280, default 130
# c Air: 2500 to 11000, default 7000
# d Level: 0.5 to 1.25, default 0.92

param a = Drive [1.2, 5.5]
param b = LowCut [80, 280]
param c = Air [2500, 11000]
param d = Level [0.5, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * d  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Radio Voice
description: AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).
script:
# Radio Voice
# AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).
# a Center: 500 to 2200, default 1050
# b Width: 180 to 900, default 420
# c Drive: 1.2 to 4, default 2.2

param a = Center [500, 2200]
param b = Width [180, 900]
param c = Drive [1.2, 4.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b  # bandpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, 10)  # bitcrush
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Vocal Comp
description: Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.
script:
# Vocal Comp
# Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.
# a Threshold: -28 to -8, default -14
# b Ratio: 2.5 to 10, default 5
# c Drive: 1 to 2.5, default 1.35

param a = Threshold [-28.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.5, 10.0]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.5]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.005; release = 0.12  # compressor
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Whisper Edge
description: Airy HPF into soft tube.
script:
# Whisper Edge
# Airy HPF into soft tube.
# a Drive: 1.1 to 3.5, default 1.9
# b HPF: 250 to 1100, default 480
# c Level: 0.55 to 1.35, default 1

param a = Drive [1.1, 3.5]
param b = HPF [250, 1100]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * c  # tube saturation

name: Doubler AM
description: Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.
script:
# Doubler AM
# Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.
# a Time: 12 to 42, default 22
# b Mix: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.32
# c Drive: 1 to 2.2, default 1.3
# d Rate: 0.2 to 4, default 1.4

param a = Time [12, 42]
param b = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.2]
param d = Rate [0.2, 4.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip
delay1: time = a + osc1 * 4; feedback = 0.08; mix = b; damp = 7000  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Acid Line
description: 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.
script:
# Acid Line
# 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.
# a Res: 0.8 to 2.6, default 1.9
# b Min: 90 to 500, default 180
# c Range: 500 to 4500, default 2400
# d Drive: 1.1 to 4, default 2

param a = Res [0.8, 2.6]
param b = Min [90, 500]
param c = Range [500, 4500]
param d = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.004; release = 0.16  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; + = env1; * = c; resonance = a  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, d)  # diode clip

name: Sidechain Pump
description: Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.
script:
# Sidechain Pump
# Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Depth: 0.4 to 1, default 0.85
# c Floor: 0 to 0.35, default 0.08

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.4, 1.0]
param c = Floor [0.0, 0.35]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Shimmer Drive
description: Tube drive into a bright high-passed hall; slow AM on the tail.
script:
# Shimmer Drive
# Tube drive into a bright high-passed hall; slow AM on the tail.
# a Drive: 1 to 3.2, default 1.7
# b Size: 0.35 to 0.9, default 0.62
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.42
# d Rate: 0.05 to 1.2, default 0.18
# e Depth: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.32
# f Damp: 0.15 to 0.65, default 0.38

param a = Drive [1.0, 3.2]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
param d = Rate [0.05, 1.2]
param e = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param f = Damp [0.15, 0.65]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
bus shine:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.78; damp = f; mix = 1; width = 0.95  # reverb
  stage2: y = x * (1.0 - e + e * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 1800; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; shine = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Wide Motion
description: Opposite-phase AM L/R for width.

name: Formant Crush
description: Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).
script:
# Formant Crush
# Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).
# a F1: 320 to 1100, default 580
# b F2: 1000 to 2800, default 1500
# c Drive: 1.3 to 4.5, default 2.4

param a = F1 [320, 1100]
param b = F2 [1000, 2800]
param c = Drive [1.3, 4.5]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 220  # bandpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
filter2: type = bandpass; center = b; width = 320  # bandpass
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Comb Taste
description: Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).
script:
# Comb Taste
# Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).
# a Time: 3 to 28, default 11
# b Feedback: 0.55 to 0.9, default 0.72
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.55
# d Drive: 1 to 2.8, default 1.5

param a = Time [3, 28]
param b = Feedback [0.55, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
param d = Drive [1.0, 2.8]
stage1: y = tube(x, d)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 7000  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 10000; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Preamp Regen Stack
description: HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.
script:
# Preamp Regen Stack
# HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 7, default 3.4
# b Regen: 0.08 to 0.48, default 0.28
# c Tone: 800 to 6500, default 3200
# d Level: 0.35 to 1.15, default 0.8

param a = Drive [1.2, 7.0]
param b = Regen [0.08, 0.48]
param c = Tone [800, 6500]
param d = Level [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.15) * d  # soft clip

name: Slapback Drive
description: Touch-sensitive OD into a real short delay slap (80–140 ms), damped feedback, diode polish.
script:
# Slapback Drive
# Touch-sensitive OD into a real short delay slap (80–140 ms), damped feedback, diode polish.
# a Drive: 1 to 6.5, default 3
# b Time: 60 to 160, default 105
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.28
# d Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.88

param a = Drive [1.0, 6.5]
param b = Time [60, 160]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.45]
param d = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.75)  # soft clip

name: Cascade Loop Dirt

script:
# Cascade Loop Dirt

# b Loop: 0.1 to 0.5, default 0.3

# d Level: 0.3 to 1.05, default 0.7

param a = Drive [1.5, 9.0]
param b = Loop [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Tone [500, 6000]
param d = Level [0.3, 1.05]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.45)  # soft clip
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.35)  # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5  # lowpass
stage4: y = softclip(y, 1.05) * d  # soft clip

name: Bass Regen Growl
description: Keep lows: tube pre (SIMD) + single y_prev regen blend + LPF. Low CPU, thick DI.
script:
# Bass Regen Growl

filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.25  # highpass

stage2: y = lerp(x, softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.3), c) * d  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Vocal Warm Loop

script:
# Vocal Warm Loop

param a = Drive [1.1, 4.5]
param b = Body [0.04, 0.32]
param c = Air [3000, 12000]
param d = Level [0.55, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.3  # highpass

stage2: y = softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.1)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.05) * d  # diode clip

name: Drum Bus Regen
description: Bus glue dirt: softclip smash -> controlled y_prev heat -> LPF. One feedback stage only.
script:
# Drum Bus Regen

param a = Drive [1.3, 7.0]

param c = Glue [1200, 10000]

stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.6)  # soft clip

filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.1) * d  # diode clip

name: Synth Feedback Lead

script:
# Synth Feedback Lead

param a = Drive [1.5, 8.0]
param b = Feed [0.12, 0.52]
param c = Cutoff [600, 7000]
param d = Level [0.3, 1.0]
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.2) * d  # soft clip

name: Dual Path Regen
description: Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.
script:
# Dual Path Regen
# Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Regen [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.9]
param d = Tone [1000, 9000]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.4)  # soft clip

filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Tight Metal Regen
description: Tight metal: HPF -> dual tube (SIMD) -> ONE hard-knee regen -> cab LPF. High gain, still hybrid-fast.
script:
# Tight Metal Regen
# Tight metal: HPF -> dual tube (SIMD) -> ONE hard-knee regen -> cab LPF. High gain, still hybrid-fast.
# a Gain: 4 to 14, default 8.5
# b Regen: 0.05 to 0.35, default 0.16

param a = Gain [4.0, 14.0]
param b = Regen [0.05, 0.35]
param c = LowCut [80, 300]
param d = Level [0.2, 0.85]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.15), 0.55)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass
stage4: y = y * d  # waveshape / mix

name: Stereo Guitar Wall
description: Two amps from one mono DI: left American high-gain-style (dark, dense), right tight lead-style (tight presence). Works with a mono guitar in (silent side is copied).
script:
# Stereo Guitar Wall
# Two amps from one mono DI: left dense American (dark, dense), right tight-lead (tight presence). Works with a mono guitar in (silent side is copied).
# a GainL: 3.5 to 12, default 7.6
# b GainR: 3.5 to 12, default 7.2
# c Tight: 55 to 200, default 95
# d Presence: 2800 to 7000, default 4800
# e Level: 0.28 to 0.95, default 0.52

param a = GainL [3.5, 12.0]
param b = GainR [3.5, 12.0]
param c = Tight [55, 200]
param d = Presence [2800, 7000]
param e = Level [0.28, 0.95]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 7; hold = 0.03; range = -80  # noise gate
split1: type = leftright {
  left {
    filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
    stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
    stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.58)  # tube saturation
    eq1: type = peak; freq = 780; q = 1.05; gain = 3.8  # peak EQ
    stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.5), 0.68)  # soft clip
    filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.52  # lowpass
    stage4: y = diode(y, 1.5) * e  # diode clip
  }
  right {
    filter3: type = highpass; cutoff = c * 1.12; resonance = 0.58  # highpass
    stage5: y = tube(x, b * 0.46)  # tube saturation
    stage6: y = tube(y, b * 0.55)  # tube saturation
    eq2: type = highshelf; freq = d; q = 0.7; gain = 3.6  # high shelf
    stage7: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.48), 0.7)  # soft clip
    filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4200; resonance = 0.48  # lowpass
    stage8: y = diode(y, 1.48) * e  # diode clip
  }
}
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: MS Side Air

name: Studio Channel Strip

name: Cinematic Space
description: Dry stays. Wet is true predelay into the hall, then MS width. No slap comb.
script:
# Cinematic Space
# Dry stays. Wet is true predelay into the hall, then MS width. No slap comb.
# a Predelay: 20 to 180, default 65
# b Size: 0.25 to 0.95, default 0.72
# c Decay: 0.35 to 0.92, default 0.7
# d Damp: 0.15 to 0.85, default 0.45
# e Mix: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.48
# f Width: 0.4 to 1.6, default 1

param a = Predelay [20, 180]
param b = Size [0.25, 0.95]
param c = Decay [0.35, 0.92]
param d = Damp [0.15, 0.85]
param e = Mix [0.2, 0.85]
param f = Width [0.4, 1.6]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus space:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0; mix = 1; damp = 8000  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = d; mix = 1; width = 0.95  # reverb
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
  ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
  stage2: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
  stage3: channel = side; y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
  ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
  stage4: y = softclip(x, 1.08)  # soft clip
out: main = 1-e; space = e  # mix buses back to the output

param e = Tone [2600, 7200]

filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.26  # lowpass
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.1) * f  # diode clip

name: Kick Rumble
description: Split kick: main is click+mids (HPF ~95, dip at 320 Hz), scream is the bright hit, body is a tight held sine+sub. Tune is the resonator. Insert on the kick, Mix 100.
script:
# Kick Rumble
# Split kick: main is click+mids (HPF ~95, dip at 320 Hz), scream is the bright hit, body is a tight held sine+sub. Tune is the resonator. Insert on the kick, Mix 100.
# a Sub: 0.55 to 1.35, default 1.02
# b Floor: 48 to 88, default 62
# c Tune: 11 to 20, default 15.5
# d Drive: 5 to 16, default 11.8
# e Decay: 0.62 to 0.9, default 0.76
# f Level: 1.05 to 1.5, default 1.26

param a = Sub [0.55, 1.35]
param b = Floor [48, 88]
param c = Tune [11, 20]
param d = Drive [5.0, 16.0]
param e = Decay [0.62, 0.9]
param f = Level [1.05, 1.5]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = 0.09  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 95; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 320; q = 1.15; gain = -5.5  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 1150; q = 1.3; gain = 5.2  # peak EQ
eq3: type = peak; freq = 3800; q = 1.7; gain = 6.4  # peak EQ
eq4: type = highshelf; freq = 6800; q = 0.7; gain = 3.2  # high shelf
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f * (0.82 + 0.28 * env1), 1.12), 0.72)  # soft clip
bus scream:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 200; resonance = 0.42  # highpass
  eq5: type = peak; freq = 3400; q = 1.35; gain = 7.4  # peak EQ
  eq6: type = peak; freq = 7200; q = 1.25; gain = 3.6  # peak EQ
  stage2: y = tube(x * d * 0.22 * (0.15 + 0.85 * env1), 1.35)  # tube saturation
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9800; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass
  stage3: y = diode(y, 1.45) * (0.08 + 0.92 * env1)  # diode clip
bus body:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter4: type = highpass; cutoff = 28; resonance = 0.16  # highpass
  filter5: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.42  # lowpass
  delay1: time = c; feedback = e; mix = 0.68; damp = 280  # delay line
  octaver1: sub = 0.95; up = 0; mix = 0.48; tone = 95; thresh = 0.03  # analog octaver
  stage4: y = tube(x, d * 0.22)  # tube saturation
  stage5: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.1), 0.7)  # soft clip
  eq7: type = peak; freq = 56; q = 0.95; gain = 5.2  # peak EQ
  filter6: type = lowpass; cutoff = 132; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass
out: main = 0.7; scream = 0.82; body = a  # mix buses back to the output

name: Warehouse Rumble
description: Same split, lower floor: click stays above 80 Hz, 320 Hz scooped, body stays under 130 Hz. Insert on the kick.
script:
# Warehouse Rumble
# Same split, lower floor: click stays above 80 Hz, 320 Hz scooped, body stays under 130 Hz. Insert on the kick.
# a Sub: 0.6 to 1.4, default 1.1
# b Floor: 42 to 80, default 56
# c Tune: 14 to 24, default 18
# d Drive: 5 to 16, default 11.4
# e Decay: 0.68 to 0.92, default 0.82
# f Level: 1.05 to 1.5, default 1.24

param a = Sub [0.6, 1.4]
param b = Floor [42, 80]
param c = Tune [14, 24]
param d = Drive [5.0, 16.0]
param e = Decay [0.68, 0.92]
param f = Level [1.05, 1.5]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = 0.14  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 82; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 310; q = 1.1; gain = -5.0  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 1050; q = 1.2; gain = 4.6  # peak EQ
eq3: type = peak; freq = 2800; q = 1.45; gain = 5.0  # peak EQ
eq4: type = highshelf; freq = 6200; q = 0.7; gain = 2.4  # high shelf
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f * (0.84 + 0.24 * env1), 1.12), 0.72)  # soft clip
bus scream:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 170; resonance = 0.38  # highpass
  eq5: type = peak; freq = 2400; q = 1.25; gain = 6.2  # peak EQ
  eq6: type = peak; freq = 6000; q = 1.2; gain = 2.8  # peak EQ
  stage2: y = tube(x * d * 0.2 * (0.12 + 0.88 * env1), 1.3)  # tube saturation
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8600; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
  stage3: y = diode(y, 1.4) * (0.08 + 0.9 * env1)  # diode clip
bus body:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter4: type = highpass; cutoff = 24; resonance = 0.16  # highpass
  filter5: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
  delay1: time = c; feedback = e; mix = 0.7; damp = 240  # delay line
  octaver1: sub = 1.05; up = 0; mix = 0.5; tone = 88; thresh = 0.028  # analog octaver
  stage4: y = tube(x, d * 0.24)  # tube saturation
  stage5: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.1), 0.7)  # soft clip
  eq7: type = peak; freq = 50; q = 0.9; gain = 6.2  # peak EQ
  filter6: type = lowpass; cutoff = 120; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
out: main = 0.68; scream = 0.72; body = a  # mix buses back to the output

name: Hardcore Clip
description: 160 BPM brick: mid bark + air on the hit, 320 Hz scooped so it stays crisp, tight body underneath. Insert on the kick.
script:
# Hardcore Clip
# 160 BPM brick: mid bark + air on the hit, 320 Hz scooped so it stays crisp, tight body underneath. Insert on the kick.
# a Drive: 6.5 to 18, default 13.6
# b Ceiling: 0.16 to 0.44, default 0.24
# c HPF: 90 to 220, default 145
# d Body: 0.45 to 1.2, default 0.88
# e Tune: 12 to 20, default 15
# f Level: 1.05 to 1.5, default 1.26

param a = Drive [6.5, 18.0]
param b = Ceiling [0.16, 0.44]
param c = HPF [90, 220]
param d = Body [0.45, 1.2]
param e = Tune [12, 20]
param f = Level [1.05, 1.5]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = 0.08  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.48  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 320; q = 1.2; gain = -5.8  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 1050; q = 1.35; gain = 8.2  # peak EQ
eq3: type = peak; freq = 3600; q = 1.55; gain = 5.8  # peak EQ
eq4: type = highshelf; freq = 7500; q = 0.7; gain = 3.2  # high shelf
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f * (0.78 + 0.28 * env1), 1.15), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9800; resonance = 0.26  # lowpass
stage2: y = diode(y, 1.45)  # diode clip
bus body:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter3: type = highpass; cutoff = 26; resonance = 0.16  # highpass
  filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 62; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
  delay1: time = e; feedback = 0.7; mix = 0.64; damp = 260  # delay line
  octaver1: sub = 0.88; up = 0; mix = 0.46; tone = 100; thresh = 0.03  # analog octaver
  stage3: y = tube(x, a * 0.2)  # tube saturation
  stage4: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.1), 0.7)  # soft clip
  filter5: type = lowpass; cutoff = 128; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
out: main = 0.92; body = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: Gabber Drive
description: New-style gabber: scooped 320 Hz, envelope-crushed highs, tight clipped sub that stays under. Insert on the kick, Mix 100.
script:
# Gabber Drive
# New-style gabber: scooped 320 Hz, envelope-crushed highs, tight clipped sub that stays under. Insert on the kick, Mix 100.
# a Drive: 6 to 18, default 13.4
# b Scoop: 90 to 220, default 145
# c Scream: 1600 to 3400, default 2300
# d Sub: 0.65 to 1.3, default 1.05
# e Dyn: 0.45 to 1.15, default 0.98
# f Level: 1 to 1.5, default 1.22

param a = Drive [6.0, 18.0]
param b = Scoop [90, 220]
param c = Scream [1600, 3400]
param d = Sub [0.65, 1.3]
param e = Dyn [0.45, 1.15]
param f = Level [1.0, 1.5]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = 0.1  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 88; resonance = 0.24  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 320; q = 1.15; gain = -6.0  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 78; q = 1.05; gain = 2.4  # peak EQ
eq3: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.4; gain = 4.6  # peak EQ
eq4: type = highshelf; freq = 7000; q = 0.7; gain = 2.6  # high shelf
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f * (0.76 + 0.24 * env1), 1.14), 0.7)  # soft clip
bus scream:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.42  # highpass
  eq5: type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.35; gain = 8.6  # peak EQ
  eq6: type = peak; freq = 6800; q = 1.35; gain = 4.0  # peak EQ
  stage2: y = tube(x * a * 0.18 * (0.12 + 0.88 * e * env1), 1.4)  # tube saturation
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 10200; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass
  stage3: y = diode(y, 1.5) * (0.08 + 0.9 * env1)  # diode clip
bus sub:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter4: type = highpass; cutoff = 24; resonance = 0.16  # highpass
  filter5: type = lowpass; cutoff = 58; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
  delay1: time = 16; feedback = 0.7; mix = 0.66; damp = 240  # delay line
  octaver1: sub = 1.0; up = 0; mix = 0.48; tone = 90; thresh = 0.028  # analog octaver
  stage4: y = tube(x, 2.6)  # tube saturation
  stage5: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.1), 0.7)  # soft clip
  filter6: type = lowpass; cutoff = 124; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
out: main = 0.58; scream = 0.95; sub = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: Acid Hash
description: Nasty 303 hash: slammed diode into a brick, then a screaming resonant LPF. Cutoff and Reso are the performance.
script:
# Acid Hash
# Nasty 303 hash: slammed diode into a brick, then a screaming resonant LPF. Cutoff and Reso are the performance.
# a Drive: 4.5 to 15, default 10.4
# b Cutoff: 180 to 3600, default 880
# c Reso: 1.4 to 3.25, default 2.78
# d Level: 0.95 to 1.5, default 1.24

param a = Drive [4.5, 15.0]
param b = Cutoff [180, 3600]
param c = Reso [1.4, 3.25]
param d = Level [0.95, 1.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 42; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 2.2), 0.48)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = c  # lowpass
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.7) * d, 0.92)  # soft clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7200; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Tekno Comb
description: Metallic tekno that rings and slams: brick clip into a loud short comb. For stabs, hoovers, off-grid hats.
script:
# Tekno Comb
# Metallic tekno that rings and slams: brick clip into a loud short comb. For stabs, hoovers, off-grid hats.
# a Drive: 5 to 15, default 11.2
# b Metal: 4 to 26, default 10
# c Feedback: 0.38 to 0.82, default 0.64
# d Tone: 1200 to 5200, default 2800
# e Level: 0.95 to 1.5, default 1.22

param a = Drive [5.0, 15.0]
param b = Metal [4, 26]
param c = Feedback [0.38, 0.82]
param d = Tone [1200, 5200]
param e = Level [0.95, 1.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.45  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.38)  # soft clip
delay1: time = b; feedback = c; mix = 0.7; damp = 3400  # delay line
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass
stage2: y = hardclip(diode(y, 1.85) * e, 0.9)  # diode clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6800; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Industrial Gate
description: Industrial smash: brick clip when open, silence when shut. Threshold is the groove.
script:
# Industrial Gate
# Industrial smash: brick clip when open, silence when shut. Threshold is the groove.
# a Drive: 5.5 to 16, default 12
# b Thresh: -40 to -10, default -24
# c Range: -80 to -18, default -58
# d Tone: 1400 to 6200, default 3600
# e Level: 1 to 1.5, default 1.26

param a = Drive [5.5, 16.0]
param b = Thresh [-40.0, -10.0]
param c = Range [-80.0, -18.0]
param d = Tone [1400, 6200]
param e = Level [1.0, 1.5]
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 4; hold = 0.016; range = c  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 78; resonance = 0.42  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.28)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.42  # lowpass
stage2: y = hardclip(diode(y, 1.85) * e, 0.9)  # diode clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7000; resonance = 0.26  # lowpass

name: Hoover Dirt
description: Hoover / off-key stab that rasps: hard fold, chorus smear, then a diode slap. For rave leads, not kicks.
script:
# Hoover Dirt
# Hoover / off-key stab that rasps: hard fold, chorus smear, then a diode slap. For rave leads, not kicks.
# a Drive: 3.2 to 12, default 7.2
# b Fold: 0.28 to 0.68, default 0.48
# c Width: 6 to 24, default 14
# d Tone: 2000 to 7800, default 4800
# e Level: 0.85 to 1.4, default 1.16

param a = Drive [3.2, 12.0]
param b = Fold [0.28, 0.68]
param c = Width [6, 24]
param d = Tone [2000, 7800]
param e = Level [0.85, 1.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 78; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = fold(softclip(x, a), -b, b)  # soft clip
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.28; mix = 0.22; damp = 5200  # delay line
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.38  # lowpass
stage2: y = hardclip(diode(y, 1.55) * e, 0.88)  # diode clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7600; resonance = 0.26  # lowpass

name: Side Delay
description: MS encode, delay only on the side, decode. Center stays dry — width without smearing a vocal or kick.
script:
# Side Delay
# MS encode, delay only on the side, decode. Center stays dry — width without smearing a vocal or kick.
# a Time: 90 to 420, default 220
# b Feedback: 0.12 to 0.62, default 0.32
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.38
# d Damp: 900 to 7000, default 3800
# e Mid: 0.7 to 1.15, default 1
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Time [90, 420]
param b = Feedback [0.12, 0.62]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.7]
param d = Damp [900, 7000]
param e = Mid [0.7, 1.15]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * e  # waveshape / mix
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d; channel = side  # delay line
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
stage2: y = softclip(x * f, 1.06)  # soft clip

name: Side Hall
description: Dry stays on main. A bus mutes mid, keeps side, then halls it. Center image stays put.
script:
# Side Hall
# Dry stays on main. A bus mutes mid, keeps side, then halls it. Center image stays put.
# a Size: 0.28 to 0.82, default 0.52
# b Decay: 0.28 to 0.8, default 0.5
# c Send: 0.12 to 0.62, default 0.32
# d Damp: 0.25 to 0.8, default 0.48
# e Tone: 3500 to 10000, default 7200
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Size [0.28, 0.82]
param b = Decay [0.28, 0.8]
param c = Send [0.12, 0.62]
param d = Damp [0.25, 0.8]
param e = Tone [3500, 10000]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.15]
stage1: y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
bus sides:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
  stage2: channel = mid; y = x * 0.0  # mute this channel
  stage3: channel = side; y = x  # waveshape / mix
  ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
  reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = d; mix = 1; width = 1.0  # reverb
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; sides = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Vocal Send
description: Insert or send: dry vocal on main, slap delay bus + small room bus. Two real time blocks, one Send each.
script:
# Vocal Send
# Insert or send: dry vocal on main, slap delay bus + small room bus. Two real time blocks, one Send each.
# a Slap: 70 to 170, default 112
# b Size: 0.2 to 0.62, default 0.38
# c Decay: 0.16 to 0.58, default 0.34
# d SlapMix: 0.08 to 0.42, default 0.18
# e RoomMix: 0.1 to 0.52, default 0.24
# f Tone: 3000 to 10000, default 6800

param a = Slap [70, 170]
param b = Size [0.2, 0.62]
param c = Decay [0.16, 0.58]
param d = SlapMix [0.08, 0.42]
param e = RoomMix [0.1, 0.52]
param f = Tone [3000, 10000]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus slap:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.14; mix = 1; damp = 5500  # delay line
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
bus room:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = 0.5; mix = 1; width = 0.82  # reverb
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1; slap = d; room = e  # mix buses back to the output

name: NY Drum Bus
description: Classic parallel smash: dry kit on main, bus is fast comp + tube + tone LPF. Blend is the mix.
script:
# NY Drum Bus
# Classic parallel smash: dry kit on main, bus is fast comp + tube + tone LPF. Blend is the mix.
# a Thresh: -28 to -8, default -16
# b Ratio: 2 to 8, default 4.2
# c Drive: 1.1 to 4, default 2.1
# d Blend: 0.15 to 0.75, default 0.42
# e Tone: 4000 to 12000, default 7800
# f Level: 0.55 to 1.2, default 0.95

param a = Thresh [-28.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.0, 8.0]
param c = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
param d = Blend [0.15, 0.75]
param e = Tone [4000, 12000]
param f = Level [0.55, 1.2]
stage1: y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
bus smash:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.004; release = 0.09  # compressor
  stage2: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
  stage3: y = softclip(y * f, 1.08)  # soft clip
out: main = 1-d; smash = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: MS Mix Desk
description: MS encode: mid gets optional tube glue, side gets HPF + gain, decode, air LPF. A mix-bus habit, not Ozone.
script:
# MS Mix Desk
# MS encode: mid gets optional tube glue, side gets HPF + gain, decode, air LPF. A mix-bus habit, not Ozone.
# a MidDrive: 0.8 to 2.4, default 1.25
# b SideHPF: 90 to 420, default 180
# c Side: 0.7 to 1.35, default 1.05
# d Glue: 0 to 0.7, default 0.28
# e Air: 6000 to 14000, default 11000
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.2, default 1

param a = MidDrive [0.8, 2.4]
param b = SideHPF [90, 420]
param c = Side [0.7, 1.35]
param d = Glue [0.0, 0.7]
param e = Air [6000, 14000]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.2]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = lerp(x, tube(x, a), d)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3; channel = side  # highpass
stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * c, 1.05)  # soft clip
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(x * f, 1.06)  # soft clip

name: Mono Below
description: MS encode, high-pass the side at the crossover, decode. Lows collapse to mono; tops keep width.
script:
# Mono Below
# MS encode, high-pass the side at the crossover, decode. Lows collapse to mono; tops keep width.
# a Crossover: 70 to 280, default 140
# b Side: 0.5 to 1.3, default 1
# c Mid: 0.85 to 1.15, default 1
# d Level: 0.8 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Crossover [70, 280]
param b = Side [0.5, 1.3]
param c = Mid [0.85, 1.15]
param d = Level [0.8, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.28; channel = side  # highpass
stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * b, 1.05)  # soft clip
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
stage3: y = x * d  # waveshape / mix

name: Slap Double
description: Dry on main, 18-42 ms slap on a bus. Thickness without a chorus LFO.
script:
# Slap Double
# Dry on main, 18-42 ms slap on a bus. Thickness without a chorus LFO.
# a Time: 16 to 48, default 26
# b Feedback: 0 to 0.28, default 0.08
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28
# d Tone: 2500 to 9000, default 6200
# e Drive: 0.8 to 2.2, default 1.15
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Time [16, 48]
param b = Feedback [0.0, 0.28]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
param d = Tone [2500, 9000]
param e = Drive [0.8, 2.2]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.15]
stage1: y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
bus slap:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = 6500  # delay line
  stage2: y = softclip(x, e)  # soft clip
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; slap = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: MS Guitar Spread
description: MS: mid stays the riff (mild tube), side gets a short delay. Rhythm stays centered, edges bloom.
script:
# MS Guitar Spread
# MS: mid stays the riff (mild tube), side gets a short delay. Rhythm stays centered, edges bloom.
# a Drive: 0.9 to 3.2, default 1.6
# b Time: 12 to 55, default 28
# c Side: 0.15 to 0.65, default 0.34
# d Tone: 2000 to 8000, default 4800
# e Mid: 0.75 to 1.2, default 1
# f Level: 0.55 to 1.15, default 0.9

param a = Drive [0.9, 3.2]
param b = Time [12, 55]
param c = Side [0.15, 0.65]
param d = Tone [2000, 8000]
param e = Mid [0.75, 1.2]
param f = Level [0.55, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = tube(x, a) * e  # tube saturation
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.12; mix = c; damp = d; channel = side  # delay line
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
stage2: y = softclip(x * f, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: MS Imager
description: True MS width + side HPF + mid level. Same idea as a simple imager; not linear-phase, not multiband.
script:
# MS Imager
# True MS width + side HPF + mid level. Same idea as a simple imager; not linear-phase, not multiband.
# a Width: 0 to 1.6, default 1.05
# b SideHPF: 80 to 500, default 160
# c Mid: 0.7 to 1.25, default 1
# d Level: 0.75 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Width [0.0, 1.6]
param b = SideHPF [80, 500]
param c = Mid [0.7, 1.25]
param d = Level [0.75, 1.2]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28; channel = side  # highpass
stage2: channel = side; y = x * a  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
stage3: y = softclip(x * d, 1.05)  # soft clip

name: Plate Send
description: Dry on main. Bus is a short pre-delay into a plate-ish room. Use as insert with Send, or on an FX return.
script:
# Plate Send
# Dry on main. Bus is a short pre-delay into a plate-ish room. Use as insert with Send, or on an FX return.
# a Predelay: 12 to 90, default 32
# b Size: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.34
# c Decay: 0.18 to 0.62, default 0.38
# d Send: 0.12 to 0.7, default 0.32
# e Damp: 0.3 to 0.85, default 0.55
# f Tone: 2800 to 9500, default 6200

param a = Predelay [12, 90]
param b = Size [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Decay [0.18, 0.62]
param d = Send [0.12, 0.7]
param e = Damp [0.3, 0.85]
param f = Tone [2800, 9500]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus plate:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.04; mix = 1; damp = 7000  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = e; mix = 1; width = 0.9  # reverb
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-d; plate = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: MS Kit Punch
description: MS encode: mid gets tube punch, side stays open with a light HPF. Kit stays in the middle.
script:
# MS Kit Punch
# MS encode: mid gets tube punch, side stays open with a light HPF. Kit stays in the middle.
# a Punch: 1 to 3.5, default 1.7
# b SideHPF: 100 to 450, default 200
# c Side: 0.75 to 1.3, default 1.05
# d Mid: 0.75 to 1.25, default 1
# e Tone: 5000 to 13000, default 9000
# f Level: 0.6 to 1.2, default 0.95

param a = Punch [1.0, 3.5]
param b = SideHPF [100, 450]
param c = Side [0.75, 1.3]
param d = Mid [0.75, 1.25]
param e = Tone [5000, 13000]
param f = Level [0.6, 1.2]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = tube(x, a) * d  # tube saturation
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28; channel = side  # highpass
stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * c, 1.05)  # soft clip
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(x * f, 1.07)  # soft clip

name: MS Presence
description: MS: mid HPF + side HPF, then a parallel presence peak on mid only. Does not replace a de-esser.
script:
# MS Presence
# MS: mid HPF + side HPF, then a parallel presence peak on mid only. Does not replace a de-esser.
# a Presence: 1800 to 5200, default 3200
# b Amount: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28
# c SideHPF: 140 to 600, default 260
# d Side: 0.7 to 1.25, default 1
# e LowCut: 70 to 200, default 110
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Presence [1800, 5200]
param b = Amount [0.12, 0.55]
param c = SideHPF [140, 600]
param d = Side [0.7, 1.25]
param e = LowCut [70, 200]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.3; channel = mid  # highpass
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3; channel = side  # highpass
stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * d, 1.04)  # soft clip
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
bus air:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  ms3: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
  eq1: type = peak; freq = a; q = 1.15; gain = 5; channel = mid  # peak EQ
  stage3: channel = mid; y = softclip(x, 1.12)  # soft clip
  stage4: channel = side; y = x * 0.0  # mute this channel
  ms4: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
out: main = 1; air = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Width Delay
description: Dry on main, ping-pong delay on a bus. Stereo movement without washing the center.
script:
# Width Delay
# Dry on main, ping-pong delay on a bus. Stereo movement without washing the center.
# a Time: 120 to 480, default 240
# b Feedback: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.36
# c Send: 0.12 to 0.62, default 0.3
# d Damp: 800 to 6500, default 3600
# e Drive: 0.8 to 2.4, default 1.2
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Time [120, 480]
param b = Feedback [0.15, 0.6]
param c = Send [0.12, 0.62]
param d = Damp [800, 6500]
param e = Drive [0.8, 2.4]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.15]
stage1: y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
bus ping:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = d; pingpong = true  # delay line
  stage2: y = softclip(x, e)  # soft clip
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; ping = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Haas Width
description: Precedence: left stays put, right is a short delay (6-40 ms). Width without a chorus. Not a true stereoizer.
script:
# Haas Width
# Precedence: left stays put, right is a short delay (6-40 ms). Width without a chorus. Not a true stereoizer.
# a Time: 6 to 40, default 18
# b Mix: 0.2 to 0.75, default 0.42
# c Tone: 3500 to 12000, default 8000
# d Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Time [6, 40]
param b = Mix [0.2, 0.75]
param c = Tone [3500, 12000]
param d = Level [0.75, 1.15]
stage1: channel = left; y = x * d  # waveshape / mix
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.04; mix = b; damp = c; channel = right  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.04)  # soft clip

name: Speech Band
description: Parallel 2-4 kHz bump so dialogue and lead lines cut. Use on a bus, not as a full mix EQ.
script:
# Speech Band
# Parallel 2-4 kHz bump so dialogue and lead lines cut. Use on a bus, not as a full mix EQ.
# a Band: 1800 to 4200, default 2800
# b Amount: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28
# c LowCut: 70 to 180, default 100
# d Air: 7000 to 13000, default 10000
# e Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Band [1800, 4200]
param b = Amount [0.12, 0.55]
param c = LowCut [70, 180]
param d = Air [7000, 13000]
param e = Level [0.75, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage1: y = x * e  # waveshape / mix
bus talk:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 1400  # bandpass
  stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.12)  # soft clip
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; talk = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Trailer Impact
description: Dry hit on main. Bus is tube smash + short pre-delay into a tight chamber. For impacts, not music.
script:
# Trailer Impact
# Dry hit on main. Bus is tube smash + short pre-delay into a tight chamber. For impacts, not music.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 4.5, default 2.4
# b Size: 0.16 to 0.48, default 0.3
# c Decay: 0.12 to 0.42, default 0.24
# d Blend: 0.18 to 0.68, default 0.4
# e Predelay: 8 to 48, default 22
# f Tone: 2500 to 8000, default 4800

param a = Drive [1.2, 4.5]
param b = Size [0.16, 0.48]
param c = Decay [0.12, 0.42]
param d = Blend [0.18, 0.68]
param e = Predelay [8, 48]
param f = Tone [2500, 8000]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus smash:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
  delay1: time = e; feedback = 0.04; mix = 1; damp = 5500  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = 0.58; mix = 1; width = 0.65  # reverb
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
  stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.08)  # soft clip
out: main = 1-d; smash = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: Score Hall
description: Predelay into a large dark hall, then MS width. Orchestral / score send. Algorithmic, not convolution.
script:
# Score Hall
# Predelay into a large dark hall, then MS width. Orchestral / score send. Algorithmic, not convolution.
# a Predelay: 24 to 140, default 68
# b Size: 0.48 to 0.95, default 0.78
# c Decay: 0.42 to 0.88, default 0.7
# d Mix: 0.18 to 0.62, default 0.36
# e Damp: 0.28 to 0.82, default 0.52
# f Width: 0.65 to 1.5, default 1.05

param a = Predelay [24, 140]
param b = Size [0.48, 0.95]
param c = Decay [0.42, 0.88]
param d = Mix [0.18, 0.62]
param e = Damp [0.28, 0.82]
param f = Width [0.65, 1.5]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus hall:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0; mix = 1; damp = 6500  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = e; mix = 1; width = 0.92  # reverb
  ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
  stage2: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
  stage3: channel = side; y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
  ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9200; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass
  stage4: y = softclip(x, 1.05)  # soft clip
out: main = 1-d; hall = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: Dialogue Seat
description: Chair-level speech: low cut, light glue, parallel presence, tiny room. For ADR and production dialogue.
script:
# Dialogue Seat
# Chair-level speech: low cut, light glue, parallel presence, tiny room. For ADR and production dialogue.
# a LowCut: 80 to 200, default 110
# b Presence: 1800 to 4000, default 2700
# c Amount: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.26
# d Room: 0.06 to 0.32, default 0.14
# e Thresh: -22 to -8, default -14
# f Air: 6000 to 12000, default 9500

param a = LowCut [80, 200]
param b = Presence [1800, 4000]
param c = Amount [0.12, 0.5]
param d = Room [0.06, 0.32]
param e = Thresh [-22.0, -8.0]
param f = Air [6000, 12000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
comp1: threshold = e; ratio = 2.6; attack = 0.006; release = 0.11  # compressor
bus talk:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = b; width = 1300  # bandpass
  stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.1)  # soft clip
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
bus room:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = 0.22; decay = 0.22; damp = 0.62; mix = 1; width = 0.45  # reverb
  filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass
out: main = 1; talk = c; room = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: Far Plane
description: Push a layer back: high-pass, long predelay, dark hall. Distance cue, not a worldizer.
script:
# Far Plane
# Push a layer back: high-pass, long predelay, dark hall. Distance cue, not a worldizer.
# a Near: 140 to 520, default 260
# b Predelay: 45 to 180, default 95
# c Size: 0.42 to 0.9, default 0.68
# d Mix: 0.28 to 0.75, default 0.48
# e Damp: 0.42 to 0.88, default 0.62
# f Level: 0.6 to 1.1, default 0.92

param a = Near [140, 520]
param b = Predelay [45, 180]
param c = Size [0.42, 0.9]
param d = Mix [0.28, 0.75]
param e = Damp [0.42, 0.88]
param f = Level [0.6, 1.1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.26  # highpass
stage1: y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
bus hall:
  send: main = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = b; feedback = 0; mix = 1; damp = 5000  # delay line
  reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.72; damp = e; mix = 1; width = 0.88  # reverb
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6800; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass
  stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.05)  # soft clip
out: main = 1-d; hall = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: Boom Tail
description: Sub-safe boom: rumble cut, tube weight, long dark tail. Park on an impact or drone send.
script:
# Boom Tail
# Sub-safe boom: rumble cut, tube weight, long dark tail. Park on an impact or drone send.
# a Drive: 1.3 to 4, default 2.2
# b Size: 0.52 to 0.95, default 0.78
# c Decay: 0.48 to 0.9, default 0.72
# d Mix: 0.2 to 0.68, default 0.4
# e Sub: 40 to 110, default 62
# f Tone: 1800 to 6500, default 3800

param a = Drive [1.3, 4.0]
param b = Size [0.52, 0.95]
param c = Decay [0.48, 0.9]
param d = Mix [0.2, 0.68]
param e = Sub [40, 110]
param f = Tone [1800, 6500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.24  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = 0.7; mix = d; width = 0.8  # reverb
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.26  # lowpass
stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.06)  # soft clip

name: Wide Canvas
description: Picture-wide sides: dry stays on main, a bus halls the side only. Big screen width, center locked.
script:
# Wide Canvas
# Picture-wide sides: dry stays on main, a bus halls the side only. Big screen width, center locked.
# a Size: 0.35 to 0.85, default 0.58
# b Decay: 0.3 to 0.75, default 0.5
# c Send: 0.14 to 0.58, default 0.32
# d Damp: 0.28 to 0.78, default 0.48
# e Mid: 0.75 to 1.2, default 1
# f Tone: 3200 to 9500, default 6800

param a = Size [0.35, 0.85]
param b = Decay [0.3, 0.75]
param c = Send [0.14, 0.58]
param d = Damp [0.28, 0.78]
param e = Mid [0.75, 1.2]
param f = Tone [3200, 9500]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage2: channel = mid; y = x * e  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
bus sides:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  ms3: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
  stage3: channel = mid; y = x * 0.0  # mute this channel
  stage4: channel = side; y = x  # waveshape / mix
  ms4: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
  reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = d; mix = 1; width = 1.0  # reverb
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; sides = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Tension Bed
description: Slow pulse on a dark hall over mild tube. Underscore bed, not a riser sample.
script:
# Tension Bed
# Slow pulse on a dark hall over mild tube. Underscore bed, not a riser sample.
# a Drive: 0.9 to 2.8, default 1.5
# b Size: 0.4 to 0.88, default 0.64
# c Mix: 0.22 to 0.7, default 0.42
# d Rate: 0.05 to 0.8, default 0.16
# e Depth: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.28
# f Tone: 2500 to 8000, default 4800

param a = Drive [0.9, 2.8]
param b = Size [0.4, 0.88]
param c = Mix [0.22, 0.7]
param d = Rate [0.05, 0.8]
param e = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param f = Tone [2500, 8000]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.7; damp = 0.62; mix = 1; width = 0.85  # reverb
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - e + e * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
stage3: y = lerp(x, softclip(y, 1.06), c)  # soft clip

name: Hot British Lead
description: 800-style lead: aggressive HPF, stacked tube, mid scoop then presence, dark cab.
script:
# Hot British Lead
# 800-style lead: aggressive HPF, stacked tube, mid scoop then presence, dark cab.
# a Gain: 2.5 to 10, default 5.8
# b Scoop: 400 to 1200, default 720
# c Presence: 2500 to 7000, default 4200
# d Level: 0.28 to 0.95, default 0.52

param a = Gain [2.5, 10.0]
param b = Scoop [400, 1200]
param c = Presence [2500, 7000]
param d = Level [0.28, 0.95]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 6; hold = 0.03; range = -80 # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 110; resonance = 0.42 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55) # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.7) # tube saturation
eq1: type = notch; freq = b; q = 1.1; gain = 0 # notch
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.7; gain = 3.5 # high shelf
stage3: y = softclip(y * 1.25, 1.45) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.48 # lowpass
stage4: y = diode(y, 1.35) * d # diode clip
ir1: mix = 0.45; gain = 0 # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08 # limiter

name: American Crunch
description: Tight American high-gain: steep HPF, triple tube, bright shelf, closed cab.
script:
# American Crunch
# Tight American high-gain: steep HPF, triple tube, bright shelf, closed cab.
# a Gain: 3 to 11, default 6.8
# b Tight: 55 to 180, default 95
# c Presence: 3000 to 8000, default 5200
# d Level: 0.22 to 0.85, default 0.4

param a = Gain [3.0, 11.0]
param b = Tight [55, 180]
param c = Presence [3000, 8000]
param d = Level [0.22, 0.85]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.48) # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.62) # tube saturation
stage3: y = tube(y, a * 0.4) # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.65; gain = 4 # high shelf
stage4: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.5), 0.72) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4300; resonance = 0.52 # lowpass
stage5: y = diode(y, 1.45) * d # diode clip

name: British Mid Grind
description: British mid grind: modest HPF, diode+tube, strong mid peak, open cab.
script:
# British Mid Grind
# British mid grind: modest HPF, diode+tube, strong mid peak, open cab.
# a Drive: 1.6 to 7.5, default 3.4
# b Mid: 500 to 1800, default 920
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.78

param a = Drive [1.6, 7.5]
param b = Mid [500, 1800]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.32 # highpass
stage1: y = diode(x, a * 0.55) # diode clip
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.5) # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 1.4; gain = 5 # peak EQ
stage3: y = softclip(y * 1.15, 1.4) * c # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6200; resonance = 0.34 # lowpass

name: Foldback Bass
description: Flip-top grind: 40 Hz HPF, mid scoop, hot tube, 4.5 kHz cab.
script:
# Foldback Bass
# Flip-top grind: 40 Hz HPF, mid scoop, hot tube, 4.5 kHz cab.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 6.5, default 2.8
# b Scoop: 280 to 900, default 520
# c Cab: 2800 to 6500, default 4500
# d Level: 0.45 to 1.2, default 0.88

param a = Drive [1.4, 6.5]
param b = Scoop [280, 900]
param c = Cab [2800, 6500]
param d = Level [0.45, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.28 # highpass
eq1: type = notch; freq = b; q = 0.9; gain = 0 # notch
stage1: y = tube(x, a) # tube saturation
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.2) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.36 # lowpass
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.15) * d # diode clip

name: Vocoder Bank
description: 8-band analog vocoder. Insert on a pad/synth (carrier). Pin the voice on Sidechain. Empty sidechain self-vocodes.
script:
# Vocoder Bank
# 8-band analog vocoder. Insert on a pad/synth (carrier). Pin the voice on Sidechain. Empty sidechain self-vocodes.
# a Mix: 0.35 to 1, default 0.92
# b Q: 0.8 to 4, default 1.35
# c Dry: 0 to 0.4, default 0.12
# d Formant: 0.72 to 1.4, default 1
# e CarrierHP: 60 to 280, default 90
# f Level: 0.7 to 1.35, default 1.08

param a = Mix [0.35, 1.0]
param b = Q [0.8, 4.0]
param c = Dry [0.0, 0.4]
param d = Formant [0.72, 1.4]
param e = CarrierHP [60, 280]
param f = Level [0.7, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.18  # highpass
stage1: y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
vocoder1: bands = 8; mix = a; q = b; formant = d; dry = c  # vocoder (voice on Sidechain)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8500; resonance = 0.2  # lowpass
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.12)  # soft clip

name: Vocoder Lite
description: 4-band vocoder, lighter CPU. Carrier on this track, voice on the Sidechain pin.
script:
# Vocoder Lite
# 4-band vocoder, lighter CPU. Carrier on this track, voice on the Sidechain pin.
# a Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.86
# b Q: 1.1 to 4.5, default 2
# c Dry: 0.08 to 0.6, default 0.32
# d Formant: 0.8 to 1.28, default 1
# e Level: 0.55 to 1.2, default 1.12

param a = Mix [0.3, 1.0]
param b = Q [1.1, 4.5]
param c = Dry [0.08, 0.6]
param d = Formant [0.8, 1.28]
param e = Level [0.55, 1.2]
stage1: y = x * e  # waveshape / mix
vocoder1: bands = 4; mix = a; q = b; formant = d; dry = c  # vocoder (voice on Sidechain)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8500; resonance = 0.2  # lowpass
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: Chime Combo
description: Top-boost chime: modest HPF, dual tube, mid scoop, airy 7 kHz cab.
script:
# Chime Combo
# Top-boost chime: modest HPF, dual tube, mid scoop, airy 7 kHz cab.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6.5, default 2.8
# b Scoop: 600 to 1600, default 980
# c Air: 4500 to 9000, default 6800
# d Level: 0.4 to 1.15, default 0.82

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Scoop [600, 1600]
param c = Air [4500, 9000]
param d = Level [0.4, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 75; resonance = 0.3 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5) # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.42) # tube saturation
eq1: type = notch; freq = b; q = 1.15; gain = 0 # notch
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.65; gain = 3.2 # high shelf
stage3: y = softclip(y * 1.12, 1.28) * d # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7200; resonance = 0.3 # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.35; gain = 0 # impulse response

name: Tight Lead Stack
description: Modern high-gain: steep HPF, triple tube, tight low cut, dark 4.2 kHz cab.
script:
# Tight Lead Stack
# Modern high-gain: steep HPF, triple tube, tight low cut, dark 4.2 kHz cab.
# a Gain: 4 to 12, default 7.4
# b Tight: 70 to 220, default 110
# c Presence: 2800 to 7000, default 4800
# d Level: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.38

param a = Gain [4.0, 12.0]
param b = Tight [70, 220]
param c = Presence [2800, 7000]
param d = Level [0.2, 0.8]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 8; hold = 0.025; range = -80 # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.58 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.46) # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.58) # tube saturation
stage3: y = tube(y, a * 0.38) # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.7; gain = 3.8 # high shelf
stage4: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.48), 0.7) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4200; resonance = 0.5 # lowpass
stage5: y = diode(y, 1.5) * d # diode clip
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 0 # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08 # limiter

name: Deluxe Sparkle

filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation

stage2: y = softclip(y, 0.95) * c  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8500; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass

param b = Punch [180, 700]

filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 35; resonance = 0.24 # highpass

stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.15) # soft clip

name: Envelope Bass Filter
description: Graphic-preamp bass: HPF, mid scoop, presence peak, tight cab, mild tube.

# Envelope Bass Filter

filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 38; resonance = 0.28 # highpass

eq2: type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.3; gain = 3.8 # peak EQ
stage1: y = tube(x, a) # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5200; resonance = 0.3 # lowpass
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.08) * d # soft clip

name: Multiband Glue
description: 3-band VCA-style: 12 dB/oct splits at LowX / HighX. Low thresh sits 4 dB higher (less kick pump), highs 2 dB lower. Butterworth-ish Q 0.71.
script:
# Multiband Glue
# 3-band VCA-style: 12 dB/oct splits at LowX / HighX. Low thresh sits 4 dB higher (less kick pump), highs 2 dB lower. Butterworth-ish Q 0.71.
# a LowX: 80 to 280, default 140
# b HighX: 1800 to 5500, default 3200
# c Thresh: -26 to -8, default -16
# d Ratio: 1.8 to 8, default 3.2
# e Attack: 0.003 to 0.04, default 0.01
# f Mix: 0.35 to 1, default 0.72

param a = LowX [80, 280]
param b = HighX [1800, 5500]
param c = Thresh [-26.0, -8.0]
param d = Ratio [1.8, 8.0]
param e = Attack [0.003, 0.04]
param f = Mix [0.35, 1.0]
bus low:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.71  # lowpass
  comp1: threshold = c + 4; ratio = d; attack = e; release = 0.16  # compressor
  stage1: y = softclip(x * 1.04, 1.06)  # soft clip
bus mid:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.71  # highpass
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.71  # lowpass
  comp2: threshold = c; ratio = d; attack = e; release = 0.12  # compressor
  stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.05)  # soft clip
bus high:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter4: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.71  # highpass
  comp3: threshold = c - 2; ratio = d * 0.85; attack = e * 0.7; release = 0.09  # compressor
  stage3: y = softclip(x, 1.04)  # soft clip
out: main = 1-f; low = f; mid = f; high = f  # mix buses back to the output

name: Envelope Shaper
description: Transient designer: fast peak env minus slower RMS body. Attack + punches the difference, Sustain + lifts the body. Clamp keeps it finite.
script:
# Envelope Shaper
# Transient designer: fast peak env minus slower RMS body. Attack + punches the difference, Sustain + lifts the body. Clamp keeps it finite.
# a Attack: -1 to 1, default 0.35
# b Sustain: -0.85 to 0.85, default -0.12
# c Fast: 0.008 to 0.05, default 0.018
# d Body: 0.08 to 0.4, default 0.18
# e Mix: 0.35 to 1, default 0.85
# f Level: 0.6 to 1.25, default 1.18

param a = Attack [-1.0, 1.0]
param b = Sustain [-0.85, 0.85]
param c = Fast [0.008, 0.05]
param d = Body [0.08, 0.4]
param e = Mix [0.35, 1.0]
param f = Level [0.6, 1.25]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = c  # envelope follower
env2: type = rms; attack = 0.014; release = d  # envelope follower
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * clamp(1 + a * (env1 - env2) + b * env2, 0.14, 3.4), e) * f  # dry/wet blend
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass

name: FET Peak Comp
description: FET peak-style FET: Input drives a fixed −16 dB threshold. Attack floor 1 ms (panel 20–800 µs). Release 50–1100 ms. Ratio 4/8/12/20. Class-A grit after GR.
script:
# FET Peak Comp
# FET peak-style FET: Input drives a fixed −16 dB threshold. Attack floor 1 ms (panel 20–800 µs). Release 50–1100 ms. Ratio 4/8/12/20. Class-A grit after GR.
# a Input: 1.2 to 6.5, default 3.4
# b Ratio: 4 to 20, default 8
# c Attack: 0.001 to 0.02, default 0.001
# d Release: 0.05 to 1, default 0.22
# e Output: 0.45 to 1.35, default 0.92

param a = Input [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Ratio [4.0, 20.0]
param c = Attack [0.001, 0.02]
param d = Release [0.05, 1.0]
param e = Output [0.45, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 28; resonance = 0.2 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -16; ratio = b; attack = c; release = d; knee = 2; makeup = 3; hpf = 80 # compressor
stage2: y = diode(y, 1.18) * e # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 16000; resonance = 0.2 # lowpass

name: All Buttons Comp
description: All-buttons-in: ratio pegged at 20, threshold −20 dB, attack 1 ms, release ~110 ms. Extra even harmonics. Drum smash, not a vocal default.
script:
# All Buttons Comp
# All-buttons-in: ratio pegged at 20, threshold −20 dB, attack 1 ms, release ~110 ms. Extra even harmonics. Drum smash, not a vocal default.
# a Input: 1.6 to 7.5, default 4.2
# b Release: 0.05 to 0.35, default 0.11
# c Output: 0.35 to 1.15, default 0.95

param a = Input [1.6, 7.5]
param b = Release [0.05, 0.35]
param c = Output [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 35; resonance = 0.22 # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -20; ratio = 20; attack = 0.001; release = b; knee = 1; makeup = 4 # compressor
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y * c, 1.25), 0.82) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.28 # lowpass

name: Optical Leveler Comp
description: optical leveler: optical, program-dependent. Attack ~10 ms, release 0.5 s (50% then hang — we use 0.48). Comp ratio ~3:1. Peak Reduction + Gain. T4-cell smoothness, tube makeup.
script:
# Optical Leveler Comp
# optical leveler: optical, program-dependent. Attack ~10 ms, release 0.5 s (50% then hang — we use 0.48). Comp ratio ~3:1. Peak Reduction + Gain. T4-cell smoothness, tube makeup.

param a = PeakRed [-28.0, -6.0]
param b = Gain [0.7, 2.2]
param c = Limit [3.0, 12.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = c; attack = 0.01; release = 0.48; knee = 6; makeup = 2; hpf = 60 # compressor
stage1: y = tube(x * b, 1.12) # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 15000; resonance = 0.2 # lowpass

name: VCA Bus Glue
description: VCA bus bus: VCA glue. Panel attack 0.1/0.3/1/3/10/30 ms (engine floor 1 ms). Release 0.1–1.0 s (Auto ≈ 0.3). Ratio 2/4/10. Default 4:1, 3 ms, 0.3 s.
script:

param c = Attack [0.001, 0.03]
param d = Release [0.1, 1.0]
param e = Makeup [0.85, 1.8]

name: Vari-Mu Bus

# Vari-Mu Bus

ms1: mode = encode # mid/side encode

ms2: mode = decode # mid/side decode
stage2: y = tube(x * d, 1.08) # tube saturation

name: VCA Punch Comp

stage2: y = diode(y, 1.22) * d # diode clip

name: Tape Echo Heads
description: tape echo: tape preamp, heads ~1.0x and 0.52x in parallel (mode 7-ish), Repeat Rate 140–620 ms, Intensity to the edge of runaway, wow ±8 ms @ 0.65 Hz, spring send.
script:
# Tape Echo Heads
# tape echo: tape preamp, heads ~1.0x and 0.52x in parallel (mode 7-ish), Repeat Rate 140–620 ms, Intensity to the edge of runaway, wow ±8 ms @ 0.65 Hz, spring send.
# a Rate: 140 to 620, default 310
# b Intensity: 0.18 to 0.78, default 0.46
# c Mix: 0.18 to 0.7, default 0.4
# d Tone: 1400 to 4800, default 2600
# e Wow: 0 to 1, default 0.35
# f Spring: 0 to 0.32, default 0.12

param a = Rate [140, 620]
param b = Intensity [0.18, 0.78]
param c = Mix [0.18, 0.7]
param d = Tone [1400, 4800]
param e = Wow [0.0, 1.0]
param f = Spring [0.0, 0.32]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 0.65; depth = 1.0 # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.58) # tube saturation
bus h1:
 send: in = 1 # feed this bus from the input
 delay1: time = a + osc1 * e * 8; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = d # delay line
 stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.08) # soft clip
bus h2:
 send: in = 1 # feed this bus from the input
 delay2: time = a * 0.52 + osc1 * e * 5; feedback = b * 0.55; mix = 1; damp = d # delay line
bus tank:
 send: in = 1 # feed this bus from the input
 reverb1: size = 0.26; decay = 0.32; damp = 0.52; mix = 1; width = 0.55 # reverb
out: main = 1-c; h1 = c * 0.58; h2 = c * 0.42; tank = f # mix buses back to the output

param b = Feedback [0.12, 0.68]
param c = Blend [0.18, 0.62]
param d = Age [1200, 3200]
param e = Chorus [0.0, 1.0]

stage1: y = tube(x, 1.45) # tube saturation
delay1: time = a + osc1 * e * 6; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d # delay line
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.08) # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.24 # lowpass

stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.04) # soft clip

name: Nonlinear Snap
description: nonlinear16 NonLin2 habit: 150–350 ms dense burst. Fixed room (no live size jumps), darker damp, short slap, recovery LPF. 80s snare room, not a hall.
script:
# Nonlinear Snap
# nonlinear16 NonLin2 habit: 150–350 ms dense burst. Fixed room (no live size jumps), darker damp, short slap, recovery LPF. 80s snare room, not a hall.
# a Burst: 0.18 to 0.34, default 0.24
# b Predelay: 10 to 26, default 16
# c Damp: 0.32 to 0.55, default 0.42
# d Mix: 0.18 to 0.62, default 0.4

param a = Burst [0.18, 0.34]
param b = Predelay [10, 26]
param c = Damp [0.32, 0.55]
param d = Mix [0.18, 0.62]
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.02; mix = 0.12; damp = 5500 # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.36; decay = a; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.68 # reverb
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 3800; q = 0.65; gain = 1.1 # high shelf
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.22 # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9500; resonance = 0.22 # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.04) # soft clip

name: Spring Tank
description: Guitar-amp / AKG-ish spring: small tank, splashy top, 22–40 ms drip delay, decay 0.26–0.48, damp 0.16–0.3. Not a plate and not a hall.
script:
# Spring Tank
# Guitar-amp / AKG-ish spring: small tank, splashy top, 22–40 ms drip delay, decay 0.26–0.48, damp 0.16–0.3. Not a plate and not a hall.
# a Decay: 0.26 to 0.48, default 0.36
# b Drip: 22 to 40, default 30
# c Splash: 0.16 to 0.3, default 0.22
# d Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.3
# e Drive: 0.9 to 2.2, default 1.25

param a = Decay [0.26, 0.48]
param b = Drip [22, 40]
param c = Splash [0.16, 0.3]
param d = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
param e = Drive [0.9, 2.2]
stage1: y = tube(x, e)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.22; damp = 7000  # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.24; decay = a; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.45  # reverb
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2100; q = 1.4; gain = 2.6  # peak EQ
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 120; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: FET Peak Catch
description: Insert on a lead vocal. Fast FET catches peaks. Mix 100.
script:
# FET Peak Catch
# Insert on a lead vocal. Fast FET catches peaks. Mix 100.
# a Drive: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Attack: 0.0002 to 0.008, default 0.001
# c Release: 0.04 to 0.28, default 0.09

param a = Drive [2, 10]
param b = Attack [0.0002, 0.008]
param c = Release [0.04, 0.28]
