filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = b; release = c; knee = 2; makeup = 3  # compressor
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3200; q = 1.1; gain = 1.8  # peak EQ

name: Opto Leveler
description: Insert after a peak catcher. Slow opto rides the level. Mix 100.
script:
# Opto Leveler
# Insert after a peak catcher. Slow opto rides the level. Mix 100.
# a Pull: 4 to 14, default 8
# b Makeup: 0 to 8, default 2.5
# c Air: 0 to 5, default 2.2

param a = Pull [4, 14]
param b = Makeup [0, 8]
param c = Air [0, 5]
stage1: y = tube(x, 0.85)  # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 3; attack = 0.012; release = 0.22; knee = 8; makeup = b  # compressor
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 9000; q = 0.6; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Serial Vocal Stack
description: Classic FET into opto on one insert. Lead vocal, Mix 100.
script:
# Serial Vocal Stack
# Classic FET into opto on one insert. Lead vocal, Mix 100.
# a Peak: 3 to 12, default 6
# b Ride: 4 to 12, default 7
# c Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6

param a = Peak [3, 12]
param b = Ride [4, 12]
param c = Air [0, 4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0008; release = 0.07; knee = 1; makeup = 2  # compressor
comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.015; release = 0.25; knee = 10; makeup = 2  # compressor
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 10000; q = 0.55; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Rap Punch Chain
description: Rap vocal insert: 80 Hz cut, fast FET, de-ess on the air band. Mix 100.
script:
# Rap Punch Chain
# Rap vocal insert: 80 Hz cut, fast FET, de-ess on the air band. Mix 100.
# a Punch: 3 to 12, default 7
# b Ess: 2 to 10, default 5
# c Presence: 0 to 5, default 2

param a = Punch [3, 12]
param b = Ess [2, 10]
param c = Presence [0, 5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = 0.0004; release = 0.05; knee = 1; makeup = 3  # compressor
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2800; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
xover1: f1 = 4200; f2 = 9000  # crossover
bus high:
  comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = 0.04; makeup = 0  # compressor
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: De-Ess Shelf
description: Insert de-ess: only the top band is compressed. Mix 100.
script:
# De-Ess Shelf
# Insert de-ess: only the top band is compressed. Mix 100.
# a Ess: 3 to 14, default 7
# b BandHz: 3500 to 8000, default 5200
# c Air: 0 to 3, default 0.8

param a = Ess [3, 14]
param b = BandHz [3500, 8000]
param c = Air [0, 3]
xover1: f1 = b; f2 = 11000  # crossover
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0006; release = 0.035; makeup = 0  # compressor
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Slap And Booth
description: Vocal send: 95 ms slap plus a small booth. Blend is wet. Mix 25–40 on a send.
script:
# Slap And Booth
# Vocal send: 95 ms slap plus a small booth. Blend is wet. Mix 25–40 on a send.
# a Slap: 70 to 140, default 95
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.42, default 0.22
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.32

param a = Slap [70, 140]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.42]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.7]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus wet:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.08; mix = 1; damp = 4500  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.22; damp = 0.55; mix = 1; width = 0.45  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; wet = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Dotted Eighth Throw
description: Pop vocal throw. Dotted 1/8, dark. Use as a send, Mix 20–35.
script:
# Dotted Eighth Throw
# Pop vocal throw. Dotted 1/8, dark. Use as a send, Mix 20–35.
# a Feedback: 0.12 to 0.48, default 0.26
# b Tone: 1800 to 6500, default 3800
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.12, 0.48]
param b = Tone [1800, 6500]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus throw:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
  delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = b  # delay line
out: main = 1-c; throw = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Quarter Note Halo
description: Ballad vocal send. Straight 1/4, wider and wetter than the dotted throw.
script:
# Quarter Note Halo
# Ballad vocal send. Straight 1/4, wider and wetter than the dotted throw.
# a Feedback: 0.18 to 0.52, default 0.3
# b Size: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.3

param a = Feedback [0.18, 0.52]
param b = Size [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.6]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus halo:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = 1/4; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 4200  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.45; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.35; width = 0.7  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; halo = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Dual Throw Lattice
description: Two throws: dotted 1/8 left-ish and 1/4. Pop chorus send.
script:
# Dual Throw Lattice
# Two throws: dotted 1/8 left-ish and 1/4. Pop chorus send.
# a Short: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# b Long: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.24
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3

param a = Short [0.1, 0.4]
param b = Long [0.12, 0.45]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus short:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 5000  # delay line
bus long:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay2: time = 1/4; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = 3600  # delay line
out: main = 1-c; short = c*0.55; long = c*0.45  # mix buses back to the output

name: Radio Band Vocal
description: AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.
script:
# Radio Band Vocal
# AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.
# a Bits: 5 to 11, default 8
# b Center: 800 to 2200, default 1400
# c Width: 400 to 1400, default 800

param a = Bits [5, 11]
param b = Center [800, 2200]
param c = Width [400, 1400]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = c  # bandpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.4), a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Telephone Cup
description: Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.
script:
# Telephone Cup
# Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.
# a Grit: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.6
# b Low: 280 to 700, default 400
# c High: 2200 to 4200, default 3000

param a = Grit [0.8, 3.5]
param b = Low [280, 700]
param c = High [2200, 4200]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.45  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip

name: Haas Vocal Double
description: Mono vocal to a tight double. Mid stays the dry word. Insert, Mix 100.
script:
# Haas Vocal Double
# Mono vocal to a tight double. Mid stays the dry word. Insert, Mix 100.
# a Offset: 8 to 28, default 16
# b Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.62
# c High: 4000 to 10000, default 7500

param a = Offset [8, 28]
param b = Width [0.3, 1]
param c = High [4000, 10000]
widen1: width = b; delay = a; bass = 140  # mono to stereo
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.55; gain = 1.4  # high shelf

name: Air Only Vocal
description: Add air without more compression. High shelf + tiny tube. Insert.
script:
# Air Only Vocal
# Add air without more compression. High shelf + tiny tube. Insert.
# a Air: 1 to 8, default 3.4
# b Warm: 0.4 to 1.6, default 0.75
# c LowCut: 40 to 140, default 70

param a = Air [1, 8]
param b = Warm [0.4, 1.6]
param c = LowCut [40, 140]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 11000; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf

name: Presence Pocket
description: 3 kHz pocket so the lyric cuts a dense mix. Light glue after.
script:
# Presence Pocket
# 3 kHz pocket so the lyric cuts a dense mix. Light glue after.
# a Cut: 0 to 6, default 2.8
# b Glue: 2 to 8, default 4.5
# c Dip: 200 to 500, default 320

param a = Cut [0, 6]
param b = Glue [2, 8]
param c = Dip [200, 500]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3100; q = 1.35; gain = a  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.1; gain = -2.2  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.006; release = 0.12; makeup = 1.5  # compressor

name: Breath Gate
description: Close-mic vocal. Gate the breaths, keep the line. Mix 100.
script:
# Breath Gate
# Close-mic vocal. Gate the breaths, keep the line. Mix 100.
# a Open: -56 to -28, default -42
# b Hold: 0.02 to 0.16, default 0.06
# c Range: -70 to -20, default -48

param a = Open [-56, -28]
param b = Hold [0.02, 0.16]
param c = Range [-70, -20]
gate1: threshold = a; hyst = 5; hold = b; range = c  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.55; gain = 1.2  # high shelf

name: Choir Widen Hall
description: Stack or choir. Width then a long hall on a send blend.
script:
# Choir Widen Hall
# Stack or choir. Width then a long hall on a send blend.
# a Width: 0.25 to 1, default 0.55
# b Hall: 0.35 to 0.75, default 0.55
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.24

param a = Width [0.25, 1]
param b = Hall [0.35, 0.75]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.5]
widen1: delay = 14; mix = a  # mono to stereo
bus hall:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.6; damp = 0.42; mix = 1; width = 0.85  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; hall = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Shout Clip Vocal
description: Screamed / shouted vocal. HPF, soft-pre hard ceiling, dark recovery.
script:
# Shout Clip Vocal
# Screamed / shouted vocal. HPF, soft-pre hard ceiling, dark recovery.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 6, default 2.8
# b Ceiling: 0.35 to 0.85, default 0.58
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4800

param a = Drive [1.4, 6]
param b = Ceiling [0.35, 0.85]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 140; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass

name: Narration Seat
description: Spoken word / VO. Gentle EQ, slow leveler, peak limit. Mix 100.
script:
# Narration Seat
# Spoken word / VO. Gentle EQ, slow leveler, peak limit. Mix 100.
# a Body: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# b Ride: 3 to 10, default 6
# c Ceiling: -3 to -0.2, default -0.8

param a = Body [0, 4]
param b = Ride [3, 10]
param c = Ceiling [-3, -0.2]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 180; q = 0.8; gain = a  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 4500; q = 0.9; gain = 1.2  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 2.5; attack = 0.02; release = 0.3; knee = 10; makeup = 1  # compressor
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.12  # limiter

name: Mid Word Side Bloom
description: MS vocal: mid stays dry words, sides get a short bloom.
script:
# Mid Word Side Bloom
# MS vocal: mid stays dry words, sides get a short bloom.
# a Bloom: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# b Size: 0.18 to 0.45, default 0.28
# c Width: 0.4 to 1, default 0.7

param a = Bloom [0.15, 0.5]
param b = Size [0.18, 0.45]
param c = Width [0.4, 1]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
stage2: channel = side; y = x  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: channel = side; size = b; decay = a; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.55; width = c  # reverb
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Vocal Plate Throw
description: Short bright plate on a send. Not a hall.
script:
# Vocal Plate Throw
# Short bright plate on a send. Not a hall.
# a Size: 0.12 to 0.38, default 0.22
# b Decay: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.32
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.26

param a = Size [0.12, 0.38]
param b = Decay [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.5]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus plate:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 220; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
  reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.35; mix = 1; width = 0.72  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; plate = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Side Air Only
description: MS: lift air on the sides only. Center stays put.
script:
# Side Air Only
# MS: lift air on the sides only. Center stays put.
# a Air: 1 to 7, default 3.2
# b AirHz: 5000 to 12000, default 8500
# c SideGain: 0.7 to 1.3, default 1

param a = Air [1, 7]
param b = AirHz [5000, 12000]
param c = SideGain [0.7, 1.3]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
eq1: channel = side; type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
stage2: channel = side; y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Parallel Vocal Smash
description: NY vocal: dry word plus a smashed bus. Blend is the smash.
script:
# Parallel Vocal Smash
# NY vocal: dry word plus a smashed bus. Blend is the smash.
# a Smash: 4 to 14, default 8
# b Tone: 2000 to 7000, default 4500
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Smash [4, 14]
param b = Tone [2000, 7000]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus smash:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
  stage2: y = tube(x, 2.2)  # tube saturation
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.08; makeup = 6  # compressor
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; smash = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Track Then Slap
description: Insert EQ/comp plus a dedicated slap send in one preset.
script:
# Track Then Slap
# Insert EQ/comp plus a dedicated slap send in one preset.
# a Glue: 3 to 10, default 5.5
# b Slap: 70 to 130, default 98
# c Send: 0.08 to 0.4, default 0.18

param a = Glue [3, 10]
param b = Slap [70, 130]
param c = Send [0.08, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3500; q = 1.05; gain = 1.6  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 4; attack = 0.003; release = 0.1; makeup = 2  # compressor
bus slap:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.06; mix = 1; damp = 5000  # delay line
out: main = 1; slap = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Talk Formant
description: Envelope moves a bandpass so the mouth shape talks. Creative insert.
script:
# Talk Formant
# Envelope moves a bandpass so the mouth shape talks. Creative insert.
# a Depth: 200 to 1600, default 700
# b Center: 700 to 1800, default 1100
# c Mix: 0.2 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Depth [200, 1600]
param b = Center [700, 1800]
param c = Mix [0.2, 1]
env1: attack = 0.008; release = 0.09  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus mouth:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = b + env1 * a; width = 650; resonance = 1.4  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; mouth = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Widen Then Slap
description: Double first, then a short slap on the wide image.
script:
# Widen Then Slap
# Double first, then a short slap on the wide image.
# a Width: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.5
# b Slap: 60 to 120, default 88
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.22

param a = Width [0.25, 0.9]
param b = Slap [60, 120]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
widen1: delay = 12; mix = a  # mono to stereo
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.1; mix = c; damp = 4800  # delay line

name: Air Band Polish
description: Crossover: compress the air band and add a silk shelf there only.
script:
# Air Band Polish
# Crossover: compress the air band and add a silk shelf there only.
# a Silk: 0 to 5, default 2.2
# b Pull: 2 to 10, default 5
# c AirHz: 6000 to 11000, default 8000

param a = Silk [0, 5]
param b = Pull [2, 10]
param c = AirHz [6000, 11000]
xover1: f1 = 250; f2 = c  # crossover
bus mid:
  eq2: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 0.8; gain = 0.6  # peak EQ
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.004; release = 0.08; makeup = 1  # compressor
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.45; gain = a  # high shelf
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Pop Lead Desk
description: Full pop insert: HPF, FET, de-ess, slap send. Mix 100, send is built in.
script:
# Pop Lead Desk
# Full pop insert: HPF, FET, de-ess, slap send. Mix 100, send is built in.
# a Peak: 3 to 11, default 6
# b Ess: 3 to 12, default 6.5
# c Throw: 0.08 to 0.35, default 0.16

param a = Peak [3, 11]
param b = Ess [3, 12]
param c = Throw [0.08, 0.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.24  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = 0.08; makeup = 2.5  # compressor
xover1: f1 = 4800; f2 = 9500  # crossover
bus high:
  comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 6; attack = 0.0008; release = 0.04  # compressor
bus throw:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = 0.22; mix = 1; damp = 4200  # delay line
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1; throw = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Intimate Whisper
description: Close whisper: high HPF, gentle gate, warm tube, no slap.
script:
# Intimate Whisper
# Close whisper: high HPF, gentle gate, warm tube, no slap.
# a Warm: 0.5 to 2.2, default 1.1
# b Open: -60 to -32, default -46
# c Air: 0 to 4, default 1.8

param a = Warm [0.5, 2.2]
param b = Open [-60, -32]
param c = Air [0, 4]
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 4; hold = 0.04; range = -36  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 7500; q = 0.55; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Green Mid Into Amp
description: TS mid-hump into a soft tube stage and vintage cab. Rhythm DI.
script:
# Green Mid Into Amp
# TS mid-hump into a soft tube stage and vintage cab. Rhythm DI.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 10, default 5
# b Amp: 0.8 to 4.5, default 2.1
# c Tone: 1200 to 5500, default 2800

param a = Drive [1.5, 10]
param b = Amp [0.8, 4.5]
param c = Tone [1200, 5500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 720; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 720; q = 1.6; gain = 5.5  # peak EQ
stage2: y = tube(y, b)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Tall Stack Fuzz
description: Muff-like stacked filters around a fold, then a dark cab.
script:
# Tall Stack Fuzz
# Muff-like stacked filters around a fold, then a dark cab.
# a Fuzz: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Scoop: 400 to 1400, default 800
# c Top: 1800 to 5000, default 3200

param a = Fuzz [2, 10]
param b = Scoop [400, 1400]
param c = Top [1800, 5000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass
stage1: y = fold(x, -0.35, 0.35)  # wavefold
stage2: y = softclip(y, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 0.9; gain = -5  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 4  # impulse response

name: Scooped Rhythm Wall
description: High-gain rhythm: tight HPF, 400 Hz scoop, gate, American cab.
script:
# Scooped Rhythm Wall
# High-gain rhythm: tight HPF, 400 Hz scoop, gate, American cab.
# a Gain: 4 to 12, default 8
# b Tight: 55 to 160, default 90
# c Scoop: -8 to -2, default -4.5

param a = Gain [4, 12]
param b = Tight [55, 160]
param c = Scoop [-8, -2]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 6; hold = 0.025; range = -78  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 400; q = 1.05; gain = c  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.5  # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.48; gain = 0  # impulse response

name: Tight Gate Lead
description: Single-note lead: faster gate, 3.5 kHz presence, British cab.
script:
# Tight Gate Lead
# Single-note lead: faster gate, 3.5 kHz presence, British cab.
# a Gain: 3 to 11, default 6.5
# b Presence: 2 to 7, default 3.8
# c Gate: -50 to -28, default -38

param a = Gain [3, 11]
param b = Presence [2, 7]
param c = Gate [-50, -28]
gate1: threshold = c; hyst = 4; hold = 0.015; range = -75  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 130; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.6)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3500; q = 1.2; gain = b  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = 0.46; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Edge Of Breakup
description: One soft tube, no cab IR. Dynamic clean-to-crunch for pickers.
script:
# Edge Of Breakup
# One soft tube, no cab IR. Dynamic clean-to-crunch for pickers.
# a Push: 0.6 to 3.2, default 1.4
# b Low: 50 to 140, default 75
# c Top: 4500 to 9000, default 6800

param a = Push [0.6, 3.2]
param b = Low [50, 140]
param c = Top [4500, 9000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 3800; q = 0.6; gain = 1.8  # high shelf
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.26  # lowpass

name: Vibe Rotary Guitar
description: optical vibe cousin: AM plus a sweeping bandpass. Slow rotary.
script:
# Vibe Rotary Guitar
# Uni-vibe cousin: AM plus a sweeping bandpass. Slow rotary.
# a Rate: 0.2 to 3, default 0.7
# b Chorus: 300 to 1800, default 800
# c AM: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.35

param a = Rate [0.2, 3]
param b = Chorus [300, 1800]
param c = AM [0.15, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
filter1: type = bandpass; center = 900 + osc1 * b; width = 700; resonance = 0.8  # bandpass
stage1: y = x * (1 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Country Slap Guitar
description: Tele / country: clean tube, 95 ms slap, light spring.
script:
# Country Slap Guitar
# Tele / country: clean tube, 95 ms slap, light spring.
# a Clean: 0.4 to 2, default 0.85
# b Slap: 70 to 130, default 95
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.35, default 0.16

param a = Clean [0.4, 2]
param b = Slap [70, 130]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.35]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.06; mix = 0.22; damp = 5200  # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.2; decay = c; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.18; width = 0.4  # reverb
ir1: mix = 0.3; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Surf Spring Crash
description: Splashier spring than Clean Spring Send. More drip, more HPF.
script:
# Surf Spring Crash
# Splashier spring than Clean Spring Send. More drip, more HPF.
# a Drip: 0.25 to 0.7, default 0.42
# b Drive: 0.5 to 2.4, default 1.1
# c Splash: 0.2 to 0.65, default 0.38

param a = Drip [0.25, 0.7]
param b = Drive [0.5, 2.4]
param c = Splash [0.2, 0.65]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = a; decay = 0.55; damp = 0.22; mix = c; width = 0.35  # reverb

name: Jazz Box Warm
description: Hollow-body jazz: low cut gentle, dark LPF, tiny tube, no IR.
script:
# Jazz Box Warm
# Hollow-body jazz: low cut gentle, dark LPF, tiny tube, no IR.
# a Warm: 0.4 to 1.8, default 0.9
# b Dark: 1800 to 4500, default 2800
# c Body: 0 to 4, default 1.8

param a = Warm [0.4, 1.8]
param b = Dark [1800, 4500]
param c = Body [0, 4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 220; q = 0.8; gain = c  # peak EQ
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Metal Scoop Cab
description: Modern metal: 90 Hz tight, 400 scoop, 1.5 kHz bark, dark cab.
script:
# Metal Scoop Cab
# Modern metal: 90 Hz tight, 400 scoop, 1.5 kHz bark, dark cab.
# a Gain: 5 to 13, default 8.5
# b Bark: 1 to 6, default 3.2
# c Cab: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.5

param a = Gain [5, 13]
param b = Bark [1, 6]
param c = Cab [0.3, 0.7]
gate1: threshold = -42; hyst = 5; hold = 0.02; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.58  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.4), 0.62)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 400; q = 1.1; gain = -6  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 1500; q = 1.15; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4200; resonance = 0.48  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 0  # impulse response

name: British Crunch Stack
description: Two British-voiced tubes, 800 Hz bark, no American scoop.
script:
# British Crunch Stack
# Two British-voiced tubes, 800 Hz bark, no American scoop.
# a Drive: 1.6 to 8, default 3.8
# b Bark: 2 to 7, default 4
# c Cab: 0.25 to 0.65, default 0.42

param a = Drive [1.6, 8]
param b = Bark [2, 7]
param c = Cab [0.25, 0.65]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 110; resonance = 0.38  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.65)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 800; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5600; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: American Clean Cab
description: Open-cab cousin with IR. Brighter and more open than Edge Of Breakup.
script:
# American Clean Cab
# Open-cab cousin with IR. Brighter and more open than Edge Of Breakup.
# a Drive: 0.4 to 2.2, default 0.95
# b Bright: 0 to 6, default 3
# c Cab: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.38

param a = Drive [0.4, 2.2]
param b = Bright [0, 6]
param c = Cab [0.2, 0.6]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 5200; q = 0.55; gain = b  # high shelf
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9800; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Lead Presence Stack
description: Lead: 4 kHz shelf, slower gate, medium cab. Sings above a rhythm wall.
script:
# Lead Presence Stack
# Lead: 4 kHz shelf, slower gate, medium cab. Sings above a rhythm wall.
# a Gain: 3 to 10, default 6
# b Air: 1 to 6, default 3
# c Sustain: 0.02 to 0.12, default 0.05

param a = Gain [3, 10]
param b = Air [1, 6]
param c = Sustain [0.02, 0.12]
gate1: threshold = -40; hyst = 4; hold = c; range = -70  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 140; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.7)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4000; q = 0.6; gain = b  # high shelf
ir1: mix = 0.44; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Rhythm Mid Scoop
description: Palm-mute rhythm. Deeper 280 Hz scoop than Scooped Rhythm Wall, less gain.
script:
# Rhythm Mid Scoop
# Palm-mute rhythm. Deeper 280 Hz scoop than Scooped Rhythm Wall, less gain.
# a Gain: 3 to 9, default 5.5
# b Scoop: -9 to -2, default -5
# c Click: 1 to 5, default 2.6

param a = Gain [3, 9]
param b = Scoop [-9, -2]
param c = Click [1, 5]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 6; hold = 0.03; range = -78  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 280; q = 1.2; gain = b  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 1.1; gain = c  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = 0.45; gain = 0  # impulse response

name: Single Coil Bright
description: Strat / tele: 5 kHz silk, light breakup, vintage cab.
script:
# Single Coil Bright
# Strat / tele: 5 kHz silk, light breakup, vintage cab.
# a Push: 0.5 to 2.6, default 1.2
# b Silk: 1 to 6, default 3.2
# c Grit: 0.4 to 1.8, default 0.8

param a = Push [0.5, 2.6]
param b = Silk [1, 6]
param c = Grit [0.4, 1.8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = diode(y, c)  # diode clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 5200; q = 0.55; gain = b  # high shelf
ir1: mix = 0.32; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Humbucker Thick
description: LP / humbucker: 200 Hz body, darker LPF, British cab.
script:
# Humbucker Thick
# LP / humbucker: 200 Hz body, darker LPF, British cab.
# a Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# b Body: 1 to 6, default 3
# c Dark: 3200 to 6500, default 4800

param a = Drive [1, 5]
param b = Body [1, 6]
param c = Dark [3200, 6500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 200; q = 0.85; gain = b  # peak EQ
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.42; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Acoustic Sim Box
description: Electric to faux-acoustic: notch body, high bandpass, tiny room.
script:
# Acoustic Sim Box
# Electric to faux-acoustic: notch body, high bandpass, tiny room.
# a Body: 200 to 500, default 320
# b Notch: -10 to -3, default -6
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.3, default 0.16

param a = Body [200, 500]
param b = Notch [-10, -3]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.3]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = a; q = 2.2; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = bandpass; center = 1800; width = 1400; resonance = 0.45  # bandpass
reverb1: size = 0.18; decay = c; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.16; width = 0.5  # reverb
stage1: y = x * 2.4  # makeup

name: Twelve String Chorus
description: Short stereo chorus + sparkle shelf. 12-string illusion.
script:
# Twelve String Chorus
# Short stereo chorus + sparkle shelf. 12-string illusion.
# a Rate: 0.4 to 2.5, default 1.1
# b Depth: 5 to 16, default 9
# c Sparkle: 1 to 5, default 2.4

param a = Rate [0.4, 2.5]
param b = Depth [5, 16]
param c = Sparkle [1, 5]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 9 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.05; mix = 0.4; damp = 8000  # delay line
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 6500; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Slide Dirt Bed
description: Slide guitar: long sustain tube, dark, small room, no gate.
script:
# Slide Dirt Bed
# Slide guitar: long sustain tube, dark, small room, no gate.
# a Sustain: 1.2 to 5, default 2.6
# b Dark: 2200 to 5200, default 3400
# c Room: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2

param a = Sustain [1.2, 5]
param b = Dark [2200, 5200]
param c = Room [0.1, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass
reverb1: size = 0.28; decay = c; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.22; width = 0.45  # reverb

name: Ambient Swell Guitar
description: Volume-swell pad: slow env opens a hall. Post-rock.
script:
# Ambient Swell Guitar
# Volume-swell pad: slow env opens a hall. Post-rock.
# a Rise: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.16
# b Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62
# c Blend: 0.25 to 0.75, default 0.48

param a = Rise [0.05, 0.4]
param b = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
param c = Blend [0.25, 0.75]
env1: attack = a; release = 0.35  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x * (0.15 + 0.85 * env1)  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: size = b; decay = 2.2; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Volume Bloom Lead
description: Env swells a tube lead into a short plate. Cinematic lead.
script:
# Volume Bloom Lead
# Env swells a tube lead into a short plate. Cinematic lead.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 3
# b Bloom: 0.04 to 0.22, default 0.09
# c Plate: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Drive [1.2, 6]
param b = Bloom [0.04, 0.22]
param c = Plate [0.15, 0.5]
env1: attack = b; release = 0.18  # envelope follower
stage1: y = tube(x * (0.2 + 0.8 * env1), a)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = 0.3; decay = c; damp = 0.38; mix = 0.28; width = 0.6  # reverb
ir1: mix = 0.3; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Pick Attack Bass
description: Env boosts 2 kHz click on picked bass. Insert.
script:
# Pick Attack Bass
# Env boosts 2 kHz click on picked bass. Insert.
# a Click: 0 to 7, default 3.2
# b Fast: 0.003 to 0.03, default 0.01
# c Low: 40 to 100, default 50

param a = Click [0, 7]
param b = Fast [0.003, 0.03]
param c = Body [40, 100]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = b  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2100; q = 1.3; gain = a * env1  # peak EQ

name: Fretless Warm Bass
description: Dark LPF, slow opto, no click. Fretless / synth bass.
script:
# Fretless Warm Bass
# Dark LPF, slow opto, no click. Fretless / synth bass.
# a Dark: 1200 to 4000, default 2400
# b Ride: 3 to 10, default 6
# c Tube: 0.4 to 1.8, default 0.9

param a = Dark [1200, 4000]
param b = Ride [3, 10]
param c = Tube [0.4, 1.8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 35; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.02; release = 0.28; knee = 8; makeup = 2  # compressor
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Synth Sub Round
description: 808 / sine sub: HPF 25, soft clip, tiny even harmonics.
script:
# Synth Sub Round
# 808 / sine sub: HPF 25, soft clip, tiny even harmonics.
# a Round: 0.4 to 2.2, default 1
# b Floor: 22 to 45, default 28
# c Ceiling: 0.4 to 0.95, default 0.72

param a = Round [0.4, 2.2]
param b = Floor [22, 45]
param c = Ceiling [0.4, 0.95]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.18  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.1), c)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 220; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
stage3: y = x * 4.2  # makeup

name: Slap Bass Pop
description: Slap bass: 3 kHz pop, fast FET, high HPF.
script:
# Slap Bass Pop
# Slap bass: 3 kHz pop, fast FET, high HPF.
# a Pop: 1 to 7, default 3.4
# b Peak: 3 to 11, default 6
# c Cut: 60 to 140, default 90

param a = Pop [1, 7]
param b = Peak [3, 11]
param c = Cut [60, 140]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.4; gain = a  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0006; release = 0.06; makeup = 2  # compressor

name: Bass Amp Cab Only
description: No extra clip: just HPF, British cab, gentle LPF.
script:
# Bass Amp Cab Only
# No extra clip: just HPF, British cab, gentle LPF.
# a Cut: 30 to 80, default 45
# b Cab: 0.25 to 0.75, default 0.48
# c Top: 2500 to 6000, default 4000

param a = Cut [30, 80]
param b = Cab [0.25, 0.75]
param c = Top [2500, 6000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
ir1: mix = b; gain = 3  # impulse response

name: Sidechain Duck Bass
description: Bass ducks from the host sidechain (kick). Mix 100.
script:
# Sidechain Duck Bass
# Bass ducks from the host sidechain (kick). Mix 100.
# a Depth: 0.2 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Release: 0.04 to 0.28, default 0.12
# c Floor: 25 to 50, default 32

param a = Depth [0.2, 0.9]
param b = Release [0.04, 0.28]
param c = Floor [25, 50]
sidechain1: mix = a  # host sidechain
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -18; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = b; source = sidechain; makeup = 0  # compressor

name: Octave Dirt Bass
description: Sub octave then a tight tube. Not Precision Octaver alone.
script:
# Octave Dirt Bass
# Sub octave then a tight tube. Not Precision Octaver alone.
# a Sub: 0.2 to 0.9, default 0.45
# b Dirt: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.6
# c Low: 30 to 70, default 42

param a = Sub [0.2, 0.9]
param b = Dirt [0.8, 3.5]
param c = Low [30, 70]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 160; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3500; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Mute Click Bass
description: Palm-mute bass: gate + 1.2 kHz click, no cab.
script:
# Mute Click Bass
# Palm-mute bass: gate + 1.2 kHz click, no cab.
# a Open: -50 to -28, default -38
# b Click: 0 to 6, default 2.8
# c Tight: 50 to 120, default 75

param a = Open [-50, -28]
param b = Click [0, 6]
param c = Tight [50, 120]
gate1: threshold = a; hyst = 5; hold = 0.02; range = -70  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1200; q = 1.4; gain = b  # peak EQ

name: Motown Bass Round
description: Round fingerstyle: 100 Hz bump, slow comp, vintage cab.
script:
# Motown Bass Round
# Round fingerstyle: 100 Hz bump, slow comp, vintage cab.
# a Boom: 1 to 6, default 3
# b Glue: 3 to 9, default 5.5
# c Cab: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Boom [1, 6]
param b = Glue [3, 9]
param c = Cab [0.15, 0.5]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 100; q = 0.8; gain = a  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.025; release = 0.22; makeup = 2  # compressor
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Foldback Bass Dark
description: Darker foldback bass cousin: more 200 Hz, less top, medium cab.
script:
# Foldback Bass Dark
# Darker foldback bass cousin: more 200 Hz, less top, medium cab.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# b Wool: 1 to 6, default 3.2
# c Cab: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.48

param a = Drive [1.2, 6]
param b = Wool [1, 6]
param c = Cab [0.3, 0.7]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.25 # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 200; q = 0.85; gain = b # peak EQ
stage1: y = tube(x, a) # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3200; resonance = 0.32 # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1 # impulse response

name: Sub Only Octave
description: Just the analog sub, no dry. Bass / guitar. Mix to taste in the host.
script:
# Sub Only Octave
# Just the analog sub, no dry. Bass / guitar. Mix to taste in the host.
# a Tone: 80 to 400, default 280
# b Level: 0.3 to 1.2, default 1.1
# c Low: 30 to 80, default 45

param a = Tone [80, 400]
param b = Level [0.3, 1.2]
param c = Low [30, 80]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
octaver1: mix = 1; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = a; thresh = 0.03  # analog octaver
stage1: y = x * b * 3.2  # makeup
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 400; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Octave Into Dirt
description: Octave then diode. Synth-bass / riff.
script:
# Octave Into Dirt
# Octave then diode. Synth-bass / riff.
# a Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5
# b Dirt: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Tone: 900 to 4000, default 2200

param a = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
param b = Dirt [1, 5]
param c = Tone [900, 4000]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 180; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = diode(x, b)  # diode clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Vocoder Formant Shift
description: Vocoder as a formant color, self if no sidechain. Voice / synth.
script:
# Vocoder Formant Shift
# Vocoder as a formant color, self if no sidechain. Voice / synth.
# a Formant: 0.6 to 1.6, default 1.05
# b Mix: 0.2 to 1, default 0.55
# c Q: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.6

param a = Formant [0.6, 1.6]
param b = Mix [0.2, 1]
param c = Q [0.8, 3.5]
vocoder1: bands = 16; formant = a; mix = b; q = c  # vocoder (voice on Sidechain)

name: Vocoder Talk Box
description: Narrower, more mouth. Sidechain voice recommended.
script:
# Vocoder Talk Box
# Narrower, more mouth. Sidechain voice recommended.
# a Formant: 0.7 to 1.8, default 1.2
# b Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.7
# c Tone: 2000 to 7000, default 4500

param a = Formant [0.7, 1.8]
param b = Mix [0.3, 1]
param c = Tone [2000, 7000]
vocoder1: bands = 12; formant = a; mix = b  # vocoder (voice on Sidechain)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Bass Synth Stack
description: Sub octave + fold + LPF. Acid / reese cousin, not Acid Hash.
script:
# Bass Synth Stack
# Sub octave + fold + LPF. Acid / reese cousin, not Acid Hash.
# a Sub: 0.3 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Fold: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Cut: 400 to 2200, default 1100

param a = Sub [0.3, 0.9]
param b = Fold [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Cut [400, 2200]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 140; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = fold(x, -b, b)  # wavefold
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass

name: Dub Feedback Cave
description: High feedback, dark, then a tiny room. Dub send.
script:
# Dub Feedback Cave
# High feedback, dark, then a tiny room. Dub send.
# a Feedback: 0.35 to 0.72, default 0.52
# b Cave: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Feedback [0.35, 0.72]
param b = Cave [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
delay1: time = 1/4; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 2800  # delay line
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.6; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.25; width = 0.5  # reverb
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix

name: Vocal Plate Short
description: Bright short plate. Lead vocal send.
script:
# Vocal Plate Short
# Bright short plate. Lead vocal send.
# a Size: 0.12 to 0.35, default 0.2
# b Decay: 0.15 to 0.45, default 0.26
# c Mix: 0.1 to 0.45, default 0.22

param a = Size [0.12, 0.35]
param b = Decay [0.15, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.1, 0.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 200; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.32; mix = c; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: De-Ess Wide
description: Wider de-ess than the vocal one. Podcast / VO.
script:
# De-Ess Wide
# Wider de-ess than the vocal one. Podcast / VO.
# a Ess: 3 to 14, default 7
# b BandHz: 2800 to 6500, default 4000
# c Range: 4 to 12, default 7

param a = Ess [3, 14]
param b = BandHz [2800, 6500]
param c = Range [4, 12]
xover1: f1 = b; f2 = 10000  # crossover
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = c; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.04  # compressor
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Vocal Opto Soft
description: Softer than optical leveler stock. Low ratio, long release.
script:
# Vocal Opto Soft
# Softer than optical stock. Low ratio, long release.
# a Pull: 3 to 12, default 6.5
# b Release: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Makeup: 0 to 6, default 1.8

param a = Pull [3, 12]
param b = Release [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Makeup [0, 6]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 2; attack = 0.018; release = b; knee = 14; makeup = c  # compressor

name: FET Then Opto
description: FET then opto on one insert. Any source.
script:
# FET Then Opto
# FET then opto on one insert. Any source.
# a Peak: 3 to 12, default 6
# b Ride: 4 to 12, default 7
# c Makeup: 0 to 5, default 1.5

param a = Peak [3, 12]
param b = Ride [4, 12]
param c = Makeup [0, 5]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0008; release = 0.07; knee = 1; makeup = 2 # compressor
comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.016; release = 0.26; knee = 10; makeup = c # compressor

name: Formant Vowel
description: Two formant peaks. Voice / synth.
script:
# Formant Vowel
# Two formant peaks. Voice / synth.
# a Vowel: 400 to 900, default 600
# b Bright: 0.6 to 1.6, default 1.05
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.65

param a = Vowel [400, 900]
param b = Bright [0.6, 1.6]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus vow:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 180; resonance = 1.4  # bandpass
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = a * b * 2.2; width = 260; resonance = 1.2  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; vow = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Loudness Clip Master
description: Soft-pre clip then limit. Not Loudness Clip stock.
script:
# Loudness Clip Master
# Soft-pre clip then limit. Not Loudness Clip stock.
# a Drive: 0.85 to 1.5, default 1.05
# b Ceiling: -1.2 to -0.15, default -0.4
# c Tone: 8000 to 16000, default 11000

param a = Drive [0.85, 1.5]
param b = Ceiling [-1.2, -0.15]
param c = Tone [8000, 16000]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.92)  # soft clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.5; gain = 0.6  # high shelf
limit1: ceiling = b; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: British Plexi Bark
description: British plexi bark: 800 Hz mid peak, dual tube, cabinet IR.
script:
# British Plexi Bark
# British plexi bark: 800 Hz mid peak, dual tube, cabinet IR.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.4
# b Bark: 2 to 7, default 4
# c Cab: 0.25 to 0.6, default 0.4

param a = Drive [1.5, 7]
param b = Bark [2, 7]
param c = Cab [0.25, 0.6]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 105; resonance = 0.36  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 800; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Tweed Edge
description: Small tweed: loose low, early breakup, vintage cab.
script:
# Tweed Edge
# Small tweed: loose low, early breakup, vintage cab.
# a Push: 0.7 to 3.5, default 1.6
# b Loose: 40 to 90, default 55
# c Cab: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.35

param a = Push [0.7, 3.5]
param b = Loose [40, 90]
param c = Cab [0.2, 0.55]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 150; q = 0.7; gain = 2  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Filter Dist Amp
description: RAT filter into a tube stage + medium cab.
script:
# Filter Dist Amp
# RAT filter into a tube stage + medium cab.
# a Dist: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Filter: 500 to 3500, default 1600
# c Amp: 0.8 to 3, default 1.6

param a = Dist [2, 10]
param b = Filter [500, 3500]
param c = Amp [0.8, 3]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3 # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.5), 0.52) # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.58 # lowpass
stage2: y = tube(y, c) # tube saturation
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 1 # impulse response

name: Fuzz Into Amp
description: Stacked-filter fuzz into a dark cab.
script:
# Fuzz Into Amp
# Stacked-filter fuzz into a dark cab.
# a Fuzz: 2 to 9, default 5
# b Scoop: 500 to 1200, default 800
# c Cab: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.45

param a = Fuzz [2, 9]
param b = Scoop [500, 1200]
param c = Cab [0.3, 0.7]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.32 # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3800; resonance = 0.4 # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 0.9; gain = -4.5 # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2 # impulse response

name: Crunch Rhythm Pedal
description: Medium crunch, 1.2 kHz, no IR.
script:
# Crunch Rhythm Pedal
# Medium crunch, 1.2 kHz, no IR.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 6, default 3.2
# b Mid: 1 to 5, default 2.6
# c Tone: 2500 to 6500, default 4200

param a = Drive [1.4, 6]
param b = Mid [1, 5]
param c = Tone [2500, 6500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1200; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Lead Satin Clip
description: Smoother lead clip + presence, no gate.
script:
# Lead Satin Clip
# Smoother lead clip + presence, no gate.
# a Drive: 1.6 to 7, default 3.5
# b Air: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.1, default 0.75

param a = Drive [1.6, 7]
param b = Air [1, 5]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 130; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) * c  # soft clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4200; q = 0.55; gain = b  # high shelf

name: Vocal Tube Desk
description: Vocal: tiny tube, HPF 80, no cab.
script:
# Vocal Tube Desk
# Vocal: tiny tube, HPF 80, no cab.
# a Warm: 0.5 to 2.2, default 1.05
# b Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# c Cut: 50 to 140, default 80

param a = Warm [0.5, 2.2]
param b = Air [0, 4]
param c = Cut [50, 140]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.5; gain = b  # high shelf

name: Drum Clip Bus
description: Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.
script:
# Drum Clip Bus
# Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.
# a Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# b Ceiling: 0.45 to 0.9, default 0.7
# c Top: 3500 to 8000, default 5500

param a = Drive [1, 5]
param b = Ceiling [0.45, 0.9]
param c = Top [3500, 8000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Mixbus Satin
description: Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.
script:
# Mixbus Satin
# Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.
# a Satin: 0.4 to 1.4, default 0.75
# b Ceiling: -1.2 to -0.2, default -0.4
# c Air: 0 to 2, default 0.6

param a = Satin [0.4, 1.4]
param b = Ceiling [-1.2, -0.2]
param c = Air [0, 2]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf
limit1: ceiling = b; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: Lo-Fi Amp Sim
description: Tiny speaker: 300–3.5 kHz + crush.
script:
# Lo-Fi Amp Sim
# Tiny speaker: 300–3.5 kHz + crush.
# a Bits: 5 to 11, default 8
# b Low: 180 to 450, default 280
# c High: 2500 to 5000, default 3500

param a = Bits [5, 11]
param b = Low [180, 450]
param c = High [2500, 5000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.5), a)  # soft clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # recovery

name: Hard Clip Club
description: Club clip lighter than Hardcore Clip.
script:
# Hard Clip Club
# Club clip lighter than Hardcore Clip.
# a Drive: 2 to 9, default 5
# b Ceiling: 0.28 to 0.7, default 0.45
# c Top: 3000 to 7000, default 4800

param a = Drive [2, 9]
param b = Ceiling [0.28, 0.7]
param c = Top [3000, 7000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.4), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass

name: Gabber Mid Bark
description: Mid bark + sub bus. Not Gabber Drive.
script:
# Gabber Mid Bark
# Mid bark + sub bus. Not Gabber Drive.
# a Bark: 2 to 8, default 4
# b Sub: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.4
# c Drive: 2 to 8, default 4.5

param a = Bark [2, 8]
param b = Sub [0.2, 0.8]
param c = Drive [2, 8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1400; q = 1.2; gain = a  # peak EQ
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, c * 0.35), 0.4)  # soft clip
bus sub:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
  stage2: y = tube(x, 1.2)  # tube saturation
out: main = 1; sub = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Acid Soft Slide
description: Softer acid than Acid Hash. Env LPF.
script:
# Acid Soft Slide
# Softer acid than Acid Hash. Env LPF.
# a Cut: 250 to 3500, default 900
# b Res: 0.7 to 2.8, default 1.5
# c Env: 200 to 2000, default 800

param a = Cut [250, 3500]
param b = Res [0.7, 2.8]
param c = Env [200, 2000]
env1: attack = 0.005; release = 0.14  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a + env1 * c; resonance = b  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, 1.3)  # diode clip

name: Industrial Chop
description: Gate + clip. Not Industrial Gate stock.
script:
# Industrial Chop
# Gate + clip. Not Industrial Gate stock.
# a Open: -36 to -14, default -24
# b Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.2
# c Hold: 0.01 to 0.08, default 0.03

param a = Open [-36, -14]
param b = Drive [1.5, 7]
param c = Hold [0.01, 0.08]
gate1: threshold = a; hyst = 4; hold = c; range = -70  # noise gate
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.55)  # soft clip
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.28  # recovery

name: Hoover Fold Club
description: Fold + chorus. Not Hoover Dirt.
script:
# Hoover Fold Club
# Fold + chorus. Not Hoover Dirt.
# a Fold: 0.18 to 0.5, default 0.3
# b Rate: 0.2 to 1.5, default 0.55
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.32

param a = Fold [0.18, 0.5]
param b = Rate [0.2, 1.5]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
stage1: y = fold(x, -a, a)  # wavefold
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 11 + osc1 * 6; feedback = 0.08; mix = c; damp = 5000  # delay line

name: Rave Stab Desk
description: Stab: fast env LPF + clip.
script:
# Rave Stab Desk
# Stab: fast env LPF + clip.
# a Cut: 400 to 4000, default 1600
# b Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# c Rel: 0.05 to 0.25, default 0.12

param a = Cut [400, 4000]
param b = Drive [1.2, 6]
param c = Rel [0.05, 0.25]
env1: attack = 0.003; release = c  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * (0.3 + 0.7 * env1); resonance = 0.8  # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, b)  # soft clip

name: Club Mono Kick
description: Force kick mono below 150 Hz.
script:
# Club Mono Kick
# Force kick mono below 150 Hz.
# a BandHz: 80 to 200, default 140
# b Weight: 0 to 4, default 1.8
# c Click: 0 to 3, default 1.2

param a = BandHz [80, 200]
param b = Weight [0, 4]
param c = Click [0, 3]
xover1: f1 = a  # crossover
bus low:
  eq1: type = peak; freq = 55; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = side; y = x * 0  # mute this channel
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
eq2: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Supersaw Glue
description: Widen + light OTT + clip. Leads / stacks.
script:
# Supersaw Glue
# Widen + light OTT + clip. Leads / stacks.
# a Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.62
# b Depth: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3
# c Drive: 0.8 to 2.2, default 1.2

param a = Width [0.3, 1]
param b = Depth [0.15, 0.55]
param c = Drive [0.8, 2.2]
widen1: width = a; delay = 12; bass = 160  # mono to stereo
ott1: depth = b; time = 0.02; in = 1  # OTT (3-band up+down)
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip

name: Drop Impact FX
description: Impact: clip + short verb + click EQ.
script:
# Drop Impact FX
# Impact: clip + short verb + click EQ.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.2
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Click: 0 to 5, default 2

param a = Drive [1.5, 7]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Click [0, 5]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.55)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 80; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.22; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.16; width = 0.5  # reverb

name: Sidechain Pad EDM
description: Four-on-the-floor duck.
script:
# Sidechain Pad EDM
# Four-on-the-floor duck.
# a Depth: 0.35 to 1, default 0.75
# b Release: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# c Floor: -24 to -8, default -14

param a = Depth [0.35, 1]
param b = Release [0.1, 0.4]
param c = Floor [-24, -8]
sidechain1: mix = a  # host sidechain
comp1: threshold = c; ratio = 10; attack = 0.001; release = b; makeup = 3; source = sidechain  # compressor
stage1: y = x * 1.25  # makeup

name: Reese Mid Growl
description: Mid grit + chorus. Bass reese.
script:
# Reese Mid Growl
# Mid grit + chorus. Bass reese.
# a Grit: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# b Rate: 0.15 to 1, default 0.4
# c BandHz: 120 to 280, default 180

param a = Grit [1, 5]
param b = Rate [0.15, 1]
param c = BandHz [120, 280]
xover1: f1 = c  # crossover
bus high:
  stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
  osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
  delay1: time = 12 + osc1 * 5; feedback = 0.06; mix = 0.25; damp = 5000  # delay line
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Festival Group Vocal
description: Gang vocal: widen + short slap + OTT.
script:
# Festival Group Vocal
# Gang vocal: widen + short slap + OTT.
# a Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.55
# b Depth: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Slap: 70 to 130, default 95

param a = Width [0.3, 1]
param b = Depth [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Slap [70, 130]
widen1: width = a; delay = 14; bass = 180  # mono to stereo
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.16; damp = 4500  # delay line
ott1: depth = b; time = 0.02; in = 1  # OTT (3-band up+down)

name: Festival Lead Clip
description: Lead: clip + 3 kHz + widen.
script:
# Festival Lead Clip
# Lead: clip + 3 kHz + widen.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 5, default 2.4
# b Cut: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# c Width: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.45

param a = Drive [1.2, 5]
param b = Cut [1, 5]
param c = Width [0.2, 0.8]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.15; gain = b  # peak EQ
widen1: width = c; delay = 11; bass = 200  # mono to stereo

name: Festival Drum Bus
description: EDM drum bus: OTT + clip + HPF.
script:
# Festival Drum Bus
# EDM drum bus: OTT + clip + HPF.
# a Depth: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.38
# b Drive: 1 to 4, default 1.8
# c Cut: 30 to 80, default 45

param a = Depth [0.2, 0.7]
param b = Drive [1, 4]
param c = Cut [30, 80]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
ott1: depth = a; time = 0.015; in = 1.1  # OTT (3-band up+down)
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.72)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # recovery

name: Tape Hiss Bed
description: Dark LPF + wow. Not Cassette.
script:
# Tape Hiss Bed
# Dark LPF + wow. Not Cassette.
# a Top: 2500 to 7000, default 4200
# b Wow: 0.2 to 1, default 0.4
# c Drive: 0.6 to 2, default 1.1

param a = Top [2500, 7000]
param b = Wow [0.2, 1]
param c = Drive [0.6, 2]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 16 + osc1 * 3; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.2; damp = 4000  # delay line
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: AM Radio Narrow
description: Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.
script:
# AM Radio Narrow
# Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.
# a Low: 350 to 700, default 500
# b High: 2000 to 3500, default 2800
# c Bits: 6 to 11, default 8

param a = Low [350, 700]
param b = High [2000, 3500]
param c = Bits [6, 11]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.3), c)  # soft clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # recovery

name: VHS Tracking
description: Wow + dark + tiny crush. Video tape.
script:
# VHS Tracking
# Wow + dark + tiny crush. Video tape.
# a Wow: 0.15 to 0.8, default 0.35
# b Bits: 6 to 12, default 9
# c Top: 2000 to 5500, default 3400

param a = Wow [0.15, 0.8]
param b = Bits [6, 12]
param c = Top [2000, 5500]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 20 + osc1 * 4; feedback = 0.1; mix = 0.18; damp = 3500  # delay line
stage1: y = bitcrush(x, b)  # bitcrush
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Broken Speaker
description: 300–2.5 kHz + fold.
script:
# Broken Speaker
# 300–2.5 kHz + fold.
# a Fold: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# b Low: 200 to 450, default 300
# c High: 1800 to 3500, default 2500

param a = Fold [0.12, 0.4]
param b = Low [200, 450]
param c = High [1800, 3500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.42  # lowpass
stage1: y = fold(x, -a, a)  # wavefold
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # recovery

name: Dusty Vinyl Bed
description: Notch + dark + gentle clip. Not Vinyl Dirt.
script:
# Dusty Vinyl Bed
# Notch + dark + gentle clip. Not Vinyl Dirt.
# a Scratch: 400 to 2000, default 900
# b Top: 3000 to 7000, default 4800
# c Dust: 0.6 to 1.8, default 1.05

param a = Scratch [400, 2000]
param b = Top [3000, 7000]
param c = Dust [0.6, 1.8]
eq1: type = notch; freq = a; q = 2.4; gain = -8  # notch
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Pocket Recorder
description: 8 kHz LPF, light crush, HPF 120.
script:
# Pocket Recorder
# 8 kHz LPF, light crush, HPF 120.
# a Bits: 6 to 12, default 9
# b Top: 4000 to 9000, default 6500
# c Cut: 80 to 200, default 120

param a = Bits [6, 12]
param b = Top [4000, 9000]
param c = Cut [80, 200]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.2), a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Telephone Then Room
description: Phone band plus a cheap room.
script:
# Telephone Then Room
# Phone band plus a cheap room.
# a Low: 280 to 600, default 400
# b High: 2400 to 4000, default 3200
# c Room: 0.1 to 0.35, default 0.2

param a = Low [280, 600]
param b = High [2400, 4000]
param c = Room [0.1, 0.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.25; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.18; width = 0.4  # reverb

name: Pad Cloud Hall
description: Long hall + slow chorus. Pads.
script:
# Pad Cloud Hall
# Long hall + slow chorus. Pads.
# a Size: 0.45 to 0.88, default 0.66
# b Rate: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.14
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.36

param a = Size [0.45, 0.88]
param b = Rate [0.05, 0.4]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
reverb1: size = a; decay = 2.4; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.85  # reverb
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 16 + osc1 * 8; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.2; damp = 6000  # delay line

name: Drone Low Bed
description: Dark drone: LPF + long verb + octave sub.
script:
# Drone Low Bed
# Dark drone: LPF + long verb + octave sub.
# a Sub: 0.1 to 0.5, default 0.25
# b Top: 400 to 1600, default 900
# c Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62

param a = Sub [0.1, 0.5]
param b = Top [400, 1600]
param c = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 120; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 2.6; damp = 0.6; mix = 0.4; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Distant Radio Amb
description: Bandpass + long verb. Memory / flashback.
script:
# Distant Radio Amb
# Bandpass + long verb. Memory / flashback.
# a Center: 700 to 1800, default 1100
# b Size: 0.35 to 0.75, default 0.52
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.35

param a = Center [700, 1800]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.75]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 900  # bandpass
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.8; damp = 0.45; mix = c; width = 0.75  # reverb

name: Impact Body Boom
description: Impact: sub bump + short clip. Not Boom Tail.
script:
# Impact Body Boom
# Impact: sub bump + short clip. Not Boom Tail.
# a Sub: 1 to 6, default 3
# b Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Room: 0.1 to 0.35, default 0.2

param a = Sub [1, 6]
param b = Drive [1, 5]
param c = Room [0.1, 0.35]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 45; q = 1.2; gain = a  # peak EQ
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.6)  # soft clip
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.28; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.18; width = 0.45  # reverb

name: Dialogue Phone
description: Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.
script:
# Dialogue Phone
# Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.
# a Low: 300 to 700, default 420
# b High: 2500 to 4200, default 3200
# c Grit: 0.5 to 2, default 1

param a = Low [300, 700]
param b = High [2500, 4200]
param c = Grit [0.5, 2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Tension Pulse
description: Slow trem + dark hall. Not Tension Bed.
script:
# Tension Pulse
# Slow trem + dark hall. Not Tension Bed.
# a Rate: 0.15 to 1.2, default 0.4
# b Size: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.48
# c Depth: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [0.15, 1.2]
param b = Size [0.3, 0.7]
param c = Depth [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (1 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.6; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.3; width = 0.65  # reverb

name: Score String Hall
description: Strings: long hall, no octave. Not Score Hall.
script:
# Score String Hall
# Strings: long hall, no octave. Not Score Hall.
# a Size: 0.4 to 0.82, default 0.6
# b Decay: 1.2 to 2.8, default 1.8
# c Mix: 0.18 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Size [0.4, 0.82]
param b = Decay [1.2, 2.8]
param c = Mix [0.18, 0.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.42; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Trailer Whoosh
description: HPF sweep + short verb. Whoosh / fly-by.
script:
# Trailer Whoosh
# HPF sweep + short verb. Whoosh / fly-by.
# a Cut: 200 to 2500, default 700
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Drive: 0.6 to 2.2, default 1.1

param a = Cut [200, 2500]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Drive [0.6, 2.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.45  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.35; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.22; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Horror Low Drone
description: Sub + dark verb. Horror bed.
script:
# Horror Low Drone
# Sub + dark verb. Horror bed.
# a Sub: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.32
# b Top: 300 to 1200, default 600
# c Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62

param a = Sub [0.15, 0.6]
param b = Top [300, 1200]
param c = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 100; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 2.4; damp = 0.7; mix = 0.38; width = 0.6  # reverb
stage1: y = x * 2.4  # makeup

name: Dialogue Air Seat
description: Dialogue: HPF 80, air, tiny booth.
script:
# Dialogue Air Seat
# Dialogue: HPF 80, air, tiny booth.
# a Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# b Cut: 60 to 140, default 85
# c Booth: 0.08 to 0.25, default 0.14

param a = Air [0, 4]
param b = Cut [60, 140]
param c = Booth [0.08, 0.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
reverb1: size = 0.16; decay = c; damp = 0.48; mix = 0.12; width = 0.35  # reverb

name: Glitch Hold Gate
description: Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.
script:
# Glitch Hold Gate
# Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.
# a Depth: 0.5 to 1, default 0.85
# b Open: -30 to -8, default -18
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.8

param a = Depth [0.5, 1]
param b = Open [-30, -8]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
osc1: shape = square; freq = 1/16; depth = 1  # LFO
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 3; hold = 0.01; range = -70  # noise gate
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * (1 - a + a * (0.05 + 0.95 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))), c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Alien Formant
description: Moving formant. Not Alien Ring.
script:
# Alien Formant
# Moving formant. Not Alien Ring.
# a Rate: 0.1 to 2, default 0.45
# b Center: 400 to 1400, default 800
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.55

param a = Rate [0.1, 2]
param b = Center [400, 1400]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.9]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus mouth:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = b + osc1 * 400; width = 220; resonance = 1.5  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; mouth = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Ring Then Verb
description: Ring mod into a hall.
script:
# Ring Then Verb
# Ring mod into a hall.
# a Freq: 50 to 300, default 110
# b Size: 0.25 to 0.65, default 0.42
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.35

param a = Freq [50, 300]
param b = Size [0.25, 0.65]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * osc1, 0.55)  # dry/wet blend
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.1; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Cascade Taps
description: Three delay times stacked. Not Cascade Loop Dirt.
script:
# Cascade Taps
# Three delay times stacked. Not Cascade Loop Dirt.
# a Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# b Feedback: 0.08 to 0.3, default 0.16
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4200

param a = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
param b = Feedback [0.08, 0.3]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
delay1: time = 1/16; feedback = b; mix = a * 0.5; damp = c  # delay line
delay2: time = 1/8; feedback = b; mix = a * 0.4; damp = c  # delay line
delay3: time = 1/4; feedback = b * 0.8; mix = a * 0.35; damp = c  # delay line

name: Impact Designer
description: Design hits: clip, sub, short room.
script:
# Impact Designer
# Design hits: clip, sub, short room.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 7, default 3
# b Sub: 0 to 6, default 2.4
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.32, default 0.16

param a = Drive [1.2, 7]
param b = Sub [0, 6]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.32]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.55)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 50; q = 1.3; gain = b  # peak EQ
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.2; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.15; width = 0.4  # reverb

name: Texture Crush
description: Crush + bandpass. Texture layer.
script:
# Texture Crush
# Crush + bandpass. Texture layer.
# a Bits: 4 to 10, default 7
# b Center: 400 to 2000, default 900
# c Width: 200 to 1200, default 500

param a = Bits [4, 10]
param b = Center [400, 2000]
param c = Width [200, 1200]
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.4), a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = c  # bandpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.25  # recovery

name: Sub Drop FX
description: Octave sub + clip. Drop FX.
script:
# Sub Drop FX
# Octave sub + clip. Drop FX.
# a Sub: 0.3 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Top: 80 to 200, default 130

param a = Sub [0.3, 0.9]
param b = Drive [1, 5]
param c = Top [80, 200]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 90; thresh = 0.04  # analog octaver
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.65)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
stage2: y = x * 6.2  # makeup

name: Glitch Buffer
description: Tiny delay, square AM. Buffer glitch.
script:
# Glitch Buffer
# Tiny delay, square AM. Buffer glitch.
# a Time: 6 to 30, default 14
# b Rate: 4 to 16, default 8
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5

param a = Time [6, 30]
param b = Rate [4, 16]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
osc1: shape = square; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.25; mix = c; damp = 6000  # delay line
stage1: y = x * (0.2 + 0.8 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Acoustic Body
description: Adds low-mid body to piezo and thin acoustics.
script:
# Acoustic Body
# Adds low-mid body to piezo and thin acoustics.
# a Body: 120 to 600, default 280
# b Res: 0.4 to 2.2, default 1.1

param a = Body [120.0, 600.0]
param b = Res [0.4, 2.2]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 500; resonance = b  # filter1: bandpass
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.08  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter2: lowpass

name: Arp Shimmer
description: Sparkle for arpeggios and sequences.
script:
# Arp Shimmer
# Sparkle for arpeggios and sequences.
# a Sparkle: 4000 to 16000, default 10000

param a = Sparkle [4000.0, 16000.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 2.5; depth = 1.0  # osc1: LFO
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.6  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = x + osc1 * 0.03  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Bitcrush Glitch
description: Digital glitch and bit reduction.
script:
# Bitcrush Glitch
# Digital glitch and bit reduction.
# a Bits: 2 to 12, default 5

param a = Bits [2.0, 12.0]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = 3000; depth = 1.0  # osc1: LFO
stage1: y = bitcrush(x + osc1 * 0.05, a)  # stage1: bitcrush
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter1: lowpass

name: Blues Break OD
description: Warm mid-forward overdrive for single coils.
script:
# Blues Break OD
# Warm mid-forward overdrive for single coils.
# a Drive: 0.2 to 5, default 2.2
# b Tone: 400 to 8000, default 2800

param a = Drive [0.2, 5.0]
param b = Tone [400.0, 8000.0]
stage1: y = tanh(x * a + 0.05) # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7 # filter1: lowpass

name: Chug Palm Mute
description: Punchy low-mid for rhythm riffs.
script:
# Chug Palm Mute
# Punchy low-mid for rhythm riffs.
# a Punch: 1 to 10, default 5
# b Low: 80 to 400, default 160
# c Gate: 0.02 to 0.4, default 0.1

param a = Punch [1.0, 10.0]
param b = Low [80.0, 400.0]
param c = Gate [0.02, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 1.6; gain = 6  # peak EQ
stage1: y = hardclip(x * a, 0.55) * (0.2 + 0.8 * step(c * 0.12, abs(x)))  # hard clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Dark Atmosphere
description: Low ominous atmosphere layer.
script:
# Dark Atmosphere
# Low ominous atmosphere layer.
# a Dark: 40 to 300, default 110

param a = Dark [40.0, 300.0]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 500; resonance = 1.1  # filter1: lowpass
stage1: y = x * 0.3 + noise(t * sr) * 0.22 + y_prev * 0.15  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter2: lowpass

name: Drum Bus Glue
description: Gentle bus compression for cohesion.
script:
# Drum Bus Glue
# Gentle bus compression for cohesion.
# a Threshold: -24 to -6, default -14
# b Ratio: 1.5 to 6, default 2.5

param a = Threshold [-24.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [1.5, 6.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.003; release = 0.09  # comp1: compressor
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + 0.1)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Harmonic Exciter
description: Exciter-Charakter über Filter + Sättigung.
script:
# Harmonic Exciter
# Exciter-Charakter über Filter + Sättigung.
# a Drive: 0.5 to 6, default 2.2
# b HighFreq: 1500 to 14000, default 5500
# c Amount: 0 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Drive [0.5, 6.0]
param b = HighFreq [1500.0, 14000.0]
param c = Amount [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.8  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = x + tanh(x * a) * c  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 18000; resonance = 0.7  # filter2: lowpass

name: Loudness Safe
description: Controlled saturation with soft clip ceiling.
script:
# Loudness Safe
# Controlled saturation with soft clip ceiling.
# a Drive: 0.5 to 4, default 1.8
# b Ceiling: 0.5 to 1, default 0.92

param a = Drive [0.5, 4.0]
param b = Ceiling [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.5  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(tanh(x * a), b)  # stage1: hard clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter2: lowpass

name: Low End Control
description: Tames boomy low end on mixes.
script:
# Low End Control
# Tames boomy low end on mixes.
# a Freq: 30 to 150, default 80

param a = Freq [30.0, 150.0]
comp1: threshold = -16; ratio = 3.5; attack = 0.02; release = 0.22  # compressor
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = a; q = 0.7; gain = -5  # low shelf
stage1: y = tanh(x * 1.2)  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Metal Scoop
description: Tight high-gain with scooped mids.
script:
# Metal Scoop
# Tight high-gain with scooped mids.
# a Gain: 2 to 14, default 8
# b Presence: 2000 to 12000, default 5200
# c Gate: 0.01 to 0.35, default 0.07

param a = Gain [2.0, 14.0]
param b = Presence [2000.0, 12000.0]
param c = Gate [0.01, 0.35]
stage1: y = hardclip(x * a, 0.55) * step(c, abs(x))  # stage1: hard clip
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.6  # filter1: highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5  # filter2: lowpass

name: Pick Attack
description: Enhances pick/pluck transients.
script:
# Pick Attack
# Enhances pick/pluck transients.
# a Attack: 0.0005 to 0.006, default 0.0022

param a = Attack [0.5, 6.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 2; release = 0.09  # env1: envelope follower
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + env1 * a + 0.1)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Pluck Bite
description: Short transient emphasis for plucks.
script:
# Pluck Bite
# Short transient emphasis for plucks.
# a Bite: 0.5 to 5, default 2.2

param a = Bite [0.5, 5.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 1; release = 0.055  # env1: envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.7  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + env1 * a * 0.2)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Podcast Voice
description: Broadcast-style compression and tone.
script:
# Podcast Voice
# Broadcast-style compression and tone.
# a Comp: 2 to 10, default 4.5
# b LowCut: 60 to 250, default 120

param a = Comp [2.0, 10.0]
param b = LowCut [60.0, 250.0]
comp1: threshold = -18; ratio = a; attack = 0.006; release = 0.14  # comp1: compressor
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = tanh(x * 1.1)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Riff Sustain
description: Singing sustain for leads.
script:
# Riff Sustain
# Singing sustain for leads.
# a Sustain: 0.001 to 0.008, default 0.0035
# b Comp: 1.5 to 8, default 3

param a = Sustain [1.0, 8.0]
param b = Comp [1.5, 8.0]
comp1: threshold = -20; ratio = b; attack = 0.008; release = 0.18  # comp1: compressor
stage1: y = tanh(x * a)  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3200; resonance = 0.8  # filter1: lowpass

name: Sub Weight
description: Adds controlled sub and tight low end.
script:
# Sub Weight
# Adds controlled sub and tight low end.
# a Sub: 40 to 180, default 90
# b Drive: 0.5 to 4, default 1.6

param a = Sub [40.0, 180.0]
param b = Drive [0.5, 4.0]
comp1: threshold = -22; ratio = 4; attack = 0.012; release = 0.2  # compressor
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = a; q = 0.8; gain = 4.5  # low shelf
stage1: y = tanh(x * b)  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Tape Wobble
description: Slow pitch/wow flutter.
script:
# Tape Wobble
# Slow pitch/wow flutter.
# a Wow: 0.1 to 3, default 0.6

param a = Wow [0.1, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # osc1: LFO
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.12 + osc1 * 0.04  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter1: lowpass

name: Telephone EQ
description: Bandpass 300-3400 Hz für Telefoncharakter.
script:
# Telephone EQ
# Bandpass 300-3400 Hz für Telefoncharakter.
# a LowCut: 120 to 500, default 300
# b HighCut: 2500 to 5000, default 3400
# c Drive: 0.8 to 2, default 1.1
# d Res: 0.3 to 1.2, default 0.6

param a = LowCut [120.0, 500.0]
param b = HighCut [2500.0, 5000.0]
param c = Drive [0.8, 2.0]
param d = Res [0.3, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = d  # filter1: highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = d  # filter2: lowpass
stage1: y = tanh(x * c)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Vocal De-Ess
description: Tames harsh sibilance.
script:
# Vocal De-Ess
# Tames harsh sibilance.
# a Freq: 4000 to 12000, default 7800
# b Depth: 0 to 1, default 0.6

param a = Freq [4000.0, 12000.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 1; release = 0.04  # env1: envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.7  # filter1: highpass
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - env1 * b * 0.35)  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Vocal Double
description: Subtle detune/double thickness.
script:
# Vocal Double
# Subtle detune/double thickness.
# a Detune: 0 to 0.4, default 0.12
# b DelayFb: 0 to 0.6, default 0.22
# c Blend: 0 to 1, default 0.45

param a = Detune [0.0, 0.4]
param b = DelayFb [0.0, 0.6]
param c = Blend [0.0, 1.0]
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - c) + (x + y_prev * b + a * 0.05) * c  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter1: lowpass

name: Vocal Presence
description: Adds clarity and forward presence.
script:
# Vocal Presence
# Adds clarity and forward presence.
# a Presence: 1500 to 8000, default 4200
# b Amount: 0 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Presence [1500.0, 8000.0]
param b = Amount [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 900; resonance = 1.0  # filter1: bandpass
stage1: y = x + tanh(x) * b * 0.25  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Vocal Warmth
description: Gentle low-mid warmth for thin voices.
script:
# Vocal Warmth
# Gentle low-mid warmth for thin voices.
# a Warmth: 200 to 900, default 420
# b Soft: 0 to 1, default 0.5

param a = Warmth [200.0, 900.0]
param b = Soft [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 500; resonance = 0.8  # filter1: bandpass
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b) + tanh(x) * b  # stage1: waveshape / mix

name: Vowel Filter
description: Zwei Bandpässe formen vokalähnliche Spektren.
script:
# Vowel Filter
# Zwei Bandpässe formen vokalähnliche Spektren.
# a Vowel: 0 to 1, default 0.35
# b Spread: 200 to 2000, default 800
# c Res: 0.5 to 3, default 1.5

param a = Vowel [0.0, 1.0]
param b = Spread [200.0, 2000.0]
param c = Res [0.5, 3.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = 500; + = a; * = 1700; width = b  # filter1: bandpass
