stage1: y = x * 1.45  # waveshape / mix  # stage1: waveshape / mix
filter2: type = bandpass; center = 1100; + = a; * = 0.7; width = b  # filter2: bandpass
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # filter3: lowpass

name: 909 Newstyle
description: 909 kick to new-style hardcore: click HPF, 320 Hz scooped, env-bricked mids, side scream, tight tube sub. Insert on the kick, Mix 100.
script:
# 909 Newstyle
# 909 kick to new-style hardcore: click HPF, 320 Hz scooped, env-bricked mids, side scream, tight tube sub. Insert on the kick, Mix 100.
# a Drive: 6 to 18, default 13.8
# b Click: 90 to 220, default 148
# c Scoop: -9 to -2, default -5.8
# d Width: 0.25 to 1.2, default 0.82
# e Sub: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.88
# f Level: 0.95 to 1.45, default 1.22

param a = Drive [6.0, 18.0]
param b = Click [90, 220]
param c = Scoop [-9.0, -2.0]
param d = Width [0.25, 1.2]
param e = Sub [0.4, 1.2]
param f = Level [0.95, 1.45]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.0008; release = 0.07  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.46  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 320; q = 1.22; gain = c  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 1180; q = 1.4; gain = 7.6  # peak EQ
eq3: type = highshelf; freq = 7800; q = 0.7; gain = 3.4  # high shelf
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f * (0.68 + 0.38 * env1), 1.2), 0.22)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 10800; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage2: channel = side; y = diode(x * a * 0.15 * d, 1.48)  # diode clip
stage3: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
bus sub:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter3: type = highpass; cutoff = 24; resonance = 0.15  # highpass
  filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 66; resonance = 0.38  # lowpass
  stage4: y = tube(x, a * 0.18)  # tube saturation
  stage5: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.08), 0.68)  # soft clip
  filter5: type = lowpass; cutoff = 118; resonance = 0.2  # lowpass
out: main = 0.94; sub = e  # mix buses back to the output

name: Crisp Brick
description: Extreme crisp distortion: transient-weighted diode into a low ceiling, then a hard recovery LPF. Kicks, hats, stabs.
script:
# Crisp Brick
# Extreme crisp distortion: transient-weighted diode into a low ceiling, then a hard recovery LPF. Kicks, hats, stabs.
# a Drive: 5.5 to 18, default 13.2
# b Ceiling: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.2
# c Snap: 0.35 to 1.2, default 0.92
# d Air: 2500 to 9000, default 7200
# e Body: 80 to 220, default 128
# f Level: 0.95 to 1.45, default 1.2

param a = Drive [5.5, 18.0]
param b = Ceiling [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Snap [0.35, 1.2]
param d = Air [2500, 9000]
param e = Body [80, 220]
param f = Level [0.95, 1.45]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.0006; release = 0.055  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 300; q = 1.15; gain = -5.2  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 3400; q = 1.45; gain = 6.8  # peak EQ
eq3: type = highshelf; freq = d; q = 0.7; gain = 4.2  # high shelf
stage1: y = diode(x * f * (0.55 + c * env1), a * 0.12)  # diode clip
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.22), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11200; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass

name: Techno Snap
description: Transient designer for techno: fast peak punch vs slower RMS body. Kicks, hats, claps, stabs.
script:
# Techno Snap
# Transient designer for techno: fast peak punch vs slower RMS body. Kicks, hats, claps, stabs.
# a Attack: 0.4 to 2.4, default 1.35
# b Sustain: 0.25 to 1.4, default 0.72
# c Rel: 0.04 to 0.28, default 0.12
# d Drive: 1.2 to 8, default 3.4
# e Tone: 1800 to 8000, default 4600
# f Level: 0.85 to 1.35, default 1.08

param a = Attack [0.4, 2.4]
param b = Sustain [0.25, 1.4]
param c = Rel [0.04, 0.28]
param d = Drive [1.2, 8.0]
param e = Tone [1800, 8000]
param f = Level [0.85, 1.35]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.04  # envelope follower
env2: type = rms; attack = 0.01; release = c  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 42; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = x * (1 + env1 * a) / (1 + env2 * b * 0.55)  # waveshape / mix
stage2: y = softclip(y * f, d * 0.28)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 320; q = 0.95; gain = -2.4  # peak EQ
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = e; q = 0.7; gain = 2.8  # high shelf
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.08), 0.88)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.2

name: Side Scream
description: Mid stays punchy. Side is env-crushed diode so width bites without wrecking the kick center.
script:
# Side Scream
# Mid stays punchy. Side is env-crushed diode so width bites without wrecking the kick center.
# a Drive: 4 to 16, default 11.6
# b Side: 0.35 to 1.4, default 0.95
# c Mid: 0.7 to 1.2, default 1
# d Air: 3000 to 9000, default 6400
# e HPF: 80 to 280, default 140
# f Level: 0.9 to 1.4, default 1.16

param a = Drive [4.0, 16.0]
param b = Side [0.35, 1.4]
param c = Mid [0.7, 1.2]
param d = Air [3000, 9000]
param e = HPF [80, 280]
param f = Level [0.9, 1.4]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = 0.09  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = tube(x * c, 1.15)  # tube saturation
stage2: channel = side; y = diode(x * a * 0.2 * b * (0.2 + 0.8 * env1), 1.55)  # diode clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = d; q = 0.7; gain = 3.6; channel = side  # high shelf
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f, 1.12), 0.78)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11500; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass

name: Offbeat Gallop
description: Hard techno rumble: punchy dry kick, dotted-16th dark delay plus hall on a low bus, tube density, env-ducked so the click stays clean. Insert on the kick.
script:
# Offbeat Gallop
# Hard techno rumble: punchy dry kick, dotted-16th dark delay plus hall on a low bus, tube density, env-ducked so the click stays clean. Insert on the kick.
# a Punch: 0.4 to 2.2, default 1.15
# b Rumble: 0.25 to 1.1, default 0.68
# c Cut: 70 to 280, default 140
# d Drive: 2 to 12, default 7.2
# e Duck: 0.35 to 1, default 0.78
# f Level: 0.85 to 1.35, default 1.08

param a = Punch [0.4, 2.2]
param b = Rumble [0.25, 1.1]
param c = Cut [70, 280]
param d = Drive [2.0, 12.0]
param e = Duck [0.35, 1.0]
param f = Level [0.85, 1.35]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = 0.075
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 28; resonance = 0.18
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = 60; q = 0.7; gain = 2.4
eq2: type = peak; freq = 3200; q = 1.15; gain = 3.8
eq3: type = peak; freq = 320; q = 1.1; gain = -3.2
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f * (0.82 + 0.22 * a * env1), 1.12), 0.72)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11000; resonance = 0.2
bus rumble:
  send: in = 1
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.12
  delay1: sync = 1/16.; feedback = 0.42; mix = 0.7; damp = 1800
  reverb1: size = 0.72; decay = 0.55; damp = 0.62; mix = 0.55; width = 0.35
  stage2: y = tube(x, d * 0.22)
  filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 130; resonance = 0.22
  stage3: y = x * (1 - e * env1)
  filter5: type = lowpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.18
out: main = 0.95; rumble = b

name: Schranz Multiband
description: Hardcore kick split: tape-ish sub, 8-bit mid bark into diode, folded click on top, then a brick. Insert on the kick.
script:
# Schranz Multiband
# Hardcore kick split: tape-ish sub, 8-bit mid bark into diode, folded click on top, then a brick. Insert on the kick.
# a Drive: 4 to 16, default 11.4
# b Bits: 5 to 11, default 8
# c Fold: 0.16 to 0.55, default 0.32
# d Split: 90 to 220, default 150
# e Air: 1600 to 4200, default 2500
# f Level: 0.9 to 1.4, default 1.16

param a = Drive [4.0, 16.0]
param b = Bits [5.0, 11.0]
param c = Fold [0.16, 0.55]
param d = Split [90, 220]
param e = Air [1600, 4200]
param f = Level [0.9, 1.4]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.0006; release = 0.06
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = 58; q = 0.7; gain = 3.2
eq2: type = peak; freq = 5000; q = 1.35; gain = 4.6
xover1: f1 = d; f2 = e
bus low:
  stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.16)
  ms1: mode = encode
  stage2: channel = side; y = x * 0
  ms2: mode = decode
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.2
bus mid:
  stage3: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, a * 0.18), b)
  stage4: y = diode(y, 1.55)
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = 820; width = 520
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.28
bus high:
  stage5: y = fold(x * (0.7 + 0.4 * env1), -c, c)
  filter4: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.28
  filter5: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.2
stage6: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f, 1.18), 0.28)
filter6: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12500; resonance = 0.2
out: low = 0.92; mid = 0.88; high = 0.7

name: Koren Stack Cab
description: Triode pre into a British mid stack, pentode-ish second tube, cab IR, then a dark shelf. Insert on a DI guitar.
script:
# Koren Stack Cab
# Triode pre into a British mid stack, pentode-ish second tube, cab IR, then a dark shelf. Insert on a DI guitar.
# a Gain: 2.5 to 12, default 7.2
# b Bass: 2 to 8, default 5.2
# c Mid: 1 to 8, default 4.4
# d Treble: 2 to 9, default 6.5
# e Presence: 2000 to 7000, default 4200
# f Level: 0.28 to 0.95, default 0.52

param a = Gain [2.5, 12.0]
param b = Bass [2.0, 8.0]
param c = Mid [1.0, 8.0]
param d = Treble [2.0, 9.0]
param e = Presence [2000, 7000]
param f = Level [0.28, 0.95]
gate1: threshold = -48; hyst = 7; hold = 0.04; range = -78
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 78; resonance = 0.32
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.42)
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = 110; q = 0.7; gain = b
eq2: type = peak; freq = 780; q = 1.05; gain = c
eq3: type = peak; freq = e; q = 0.85; gain = d * 0.45
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.38)
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.35), 0.62)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5200; resonance = 0.42
ir1: mix = 0.48; gain = 0
eq4: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.7; gain = -2.4
stage4: y = diode(y, 1.15) * f
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.08

name: Streaming Ceiling
description: Mixbus density: 25 Hz cut, 60 Hz boost with a 220 Hz scoop, VCA glue, 3 kHz presence, then a soft-knee ceiling. Insert on the mix.
script:
# Streaming Ceiling
# Mixbus density: 25 Hz cut, 60 Hz boost with a 220 Hz scoop, VCA glue, 3 kHz presence, then a soft-knee ceiling. Insert on the mix.
# a Boost: 1 to 6, default 3.4
# b Glue: -22 to -6, default -12
# c Air: 1 to 5, default 3.2
# d Drive: 0.8 to 2.4, default 1.35
# e Ceiling: 0.55 to 0.92, default 0.78
# f Level: 0.7 to 1.15, default 0.95

param a = Boost [1.0, 6.0]
param b = Glue [-22.0, -6.0]
param c = Air [1.0, 5.0]
param d = Drive [0.8, 2.4]
param e = Ceiling [0.55, 0.92]
param f = Level [0.7, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 26; resonance = 0.18
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = 60; q = 0.7; gain = a
eq2: type = peak; freq = 210; q = 0.95; gain = -a * 0.55
eq3: type = highshelf; freq = 14000; q = 0.65; gain = c * 0.55
comp1: threshold = b; ratio = 4; attack = 0.03; release = 0.22; knee = 6; makeup = 2; hpf = 130
eq4: type = peak; freq = 3200; q = 1.05; gain = 1.6
stage1: y = tube(x, d * 0.55)
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(x * f, 1.08), e)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 18000; resonance = 0.18
limit1: ceiling = -1.0; release = 0.05

name: FET All In
description: FET smash: 20:1-ish, hair-trigger attack, short release, tube grit. Drums, vocals, whole buses.
script:
# FET All In
# FET smash: 20:1-ish, hair-trigger attack, short release, tube grit. Drums, vocals, whole buses.
# a Drive: 6 to 24, default 16
# b Attack: 0.001 to 0.008, default 0.0015
# c Release: 0.04 to 0.22, default 0.055
# d Output: -8 to 4, default -2
# e Color: 0.8 to 2.2, default 1.35
# f Mix: 0.45 to 1, default 0.92

param a = Drive [6.0, 24.0]
param b = Attack [0.001, 0.008]
param c = Release [0.04, 0.22]
param d = Output [-8.0, 4.0]
param e = Color [0.8, 2.2]
param f = Mix [0.45, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.16
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 18; attack = b; release = c; knee = 0; makeup = 6
stage1: y = tube(x, e)
stage2: y = lerp(x, y, f)
eq1: type = peak; freq = 80; q = 0.7; gain = d * 0.15
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.1), 0.88)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 16000; resonance = 0.16

name: Precision Multiband
description: Three-band control: pinned low, lifted mid, tamed air. Insert on a mix or bus.
script:
# Precision Multiband
# Three-band control: pinned low, lifted mid, tamed air. Insert on a mix or bus.
# a Low: -22 to -8, default -16
# b Mid: -32 to -14, default -24
# c Air: -20 to -8, default -14
# d Split: 80 to 200, default 120
# e Top: 3500 to 8000, default 6000
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.2, default 0.98

param a = Low [-22.0, -8.0]
param b = Mid [-32.0, -14.0]
param c = Air [-20.0, -8.0]
param d = Split [80, 200]
param e = Top [3500, 8000]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.2]
xover1: f1 = d; f2 = e
bus low:
  comp1: threshold = a; ratio = 5.5; attack = 0.012; release = 0.16; makeup = 2; hpf = 0
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.16
bus mid:
  ott1: depth = 0.28; time = 0.02; in = 1
  comp2: threshold = b; ratio = 2.4; attack = 0.03; release = 0.09; makeup = 1.5
bus high:
  comp3: threshold = c; ratio = 4; attack = 0.004; release = 0.035; makeup = 0.5
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.55; gain = 1.2
stage1: y = softclip(x * f, 1.06)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 17500; resonance = 0.16
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: British Desk EQ
description: Channel desk: 50 Hz cut, 110 Hz shelf, proportional mid bell, fixed 12 kHz air, light transformer tube.
script:
# British Desk EQ
# Channel desk: 50 Hz cut, 110 Hz shelf, proportional mid bell, fixed 12 kHz air, light transformer tube.
# a Pre: 0 to 8, default 3.2
# b Low: -4 to 6, default 2.4
# c MidHz: 360 to 7200, default 1600
# d Mid: -6 to 6, default -1.6
# e Air: -2 to 6, default 3.2
# f Level: 0.7 to 1.2, default 0.98

param a = Pre [0.0, 8.0]
param b = Low [ -4.0, 6.0]
param c = MidHz [360, 7200]
param d = Mid [ -6.0, 6.0]
param e = Air [ -2.0, 6.0]
param f = Level [0.7, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.22
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.05 + a * 0.08)
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = 110; q = 0.7; gain = b
eq2: type = peak; freq = c; q = 0.7 + abs(d) * 0.12; gain = d
eq3: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.7; gain = e
stage2: y = softclip(x * f, 1.06)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 18000; resonance = 0.16

name: Passive Low Trick
description: Passive low trick: boost and cut at 30-60 Hz so the fundamental rises and 200 Hz scoops. Tube makeup, broad air.
script:
# Passive Low Trick
# Passive low trick: boost and cut at 30-60 Hz so the fundamental rises and 200 Hz scoops. Tube makeup, broad air.
# a Boost: 2 to 8, default 4.6
# b Cut: 1 to 6, default 2.8
# c Freq: 28 to 80, default 42
# d Air: 0 to 7, default 4.2
# e Tube: 0.8 to 2, default 1.2
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.2, default 0.98

param a = Boost [2.0, 8.0]
param b = Cut [1.0, 6.0]
param c = Freq [28, 80]
param d = Air [0.0, 7.0]
param e = Tube [0.8, 2.0]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.2]
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = c; q = 0.65; gain = a
eq2: type = peak; freq = c * 3.4; q = 0.85; gain = -b
eq3: type = highshelf; freq = 10000; q = 0.55; gain = d
stage1: y = tube(x, e)
stage2: y = softclip(x * f, 1.05)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 17500; resonance = 0.16

name: Ladder Sweep
description: Near-oscillation ladder: LFO walks a 4-pole-ish LPF from a floor up, diode polish. For pads, leads, risers.
script:
# Ladder Sweep
# Near-oscillation ladder: LFO walks a 4-pole-ish LPF from a floor up, diode polish. For pads, leads, risers.
# a Rate: 0.04 to 2.5, default 0.18
# b Floor: 80 to 600, default 160
# c Span: 400 to 6000, default 2400
# d Res: 0.6 to 3.1, default 2.4
# e Drive: 0.9 to 2.6, default 1.45
# f Level: 0.7 to 1.2, default 0.96

param a = Rate [0.04, 2.5]
param b = Floor [80, 600]
param c = Span [400, 6000]
param d = Res [0.6, 3.1]
param e = Drive [0.9, 2.6]
param f = Level [0.7, 1.2]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c; resonance = d
stage1: y = diode(x, e)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.2
stage2: y = softclip(y * f, 1.08)

name: Octave Cloud
description: Shimmer: 500 ms delay, octave-up in the wet, damped hall. Dry stays put.
script:
# Octave Cloud
# Shimmer: 500 ms delay, octave-up in the wet, damped hall. Dry stays put.
# a Time: 280 to 720, default 500
# b Feedback: 0.25 to 0.72, default 0.48
# c Octave: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.62
# d Size: 0.45 to 0.95, default 0.78
# e Mix: 0.18 to 0.7, default 0.38
# f Damp: 2500 to 9000, default 6200

param a = Time [280, 720]
param b = Feedback [0.25, 0.72]
param c = Octave [0.25, 0.9]
param d = Size [0.45, 0.95]
param e = Mix [0.18, 0.7]
param f = Damp [2500, 9000]
stage1: y = x
bus cloud:
  send: in = 1
  delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = f
  octaver1: mix = c; sub = 0; up = 1; tone = 2400; thresh = 0.04
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.22
  reverb1: size = d; decay = 0.72; damp = 0.42; mix = 0.7; width = 0.95
  filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.16
out: main = 1; cloud = e

name: Blackwall Space
description: Cyberpunk wreck: fold, slow bandpass sweep, huge hall, opto-ish pump. For vocals, synths, field recordings.
script:
# Blackwall Space
# Cyberpunk wreck: fold, slow bandpass sweep, huge hall, opto-ish pump. For vocals, synths, field recordings.
# a Fold: 0.18 to 0.62, default 0.36
# b Rate: 0.04 to 0.4, default 0.1
# c Size: 0.55 to 0.98, default 0.86
# d Pump: -36 to -14, default -26
# e Mix: 0.35 to 0.92, default 0.7
# f Level: 0.55 to 1.15, default 0.88

param a = Fold [0.18, 0.62]
param b = Rate [0.04, 0.4]
param c = Size [0.55, 0.98]
param d = Pump [-36.0, -14.0]
param e = Mix [0.35, 0.92]
param f = Level [0.55, 1.15]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.22
stage1: y = fold(softclip(x, 1.4), -a, a)
filter2: type = bandpass; center = 400 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 3200; width = 900
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.88; damp = 0.38; mix = 0.82; width = 1
comp1: threshold = d; ratio = 8; attack = 0.05; release = 0.45; knee = 8; makeup = 3
stage2: y = lerp(x, y, e) * f
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.2

name: Click Sustain
description: Differential transient: fast peak vs slow RMS. Attack clicks up, body ducks. Kicks, hats, claps.
script:
# Click Sustain
# Differential transient: fast peak vs slow RMS. Attack clicks up, body ducks. Kicks, hats, claps.
# a Attack: 0.5 to 3.2, default 1.7
# b Body: 0.2 to 1.6, default 0.85
# c Rel: 0.03 to 0.28, default 0.1
# d Harm: 0.8 to 2.4, default 1.35
# e Tone: 1800 to 8000, default 4800
# f Level: 0.8 to 1.3, default 1.05

param a = Attack [0.5, 3.2]
param b = Body [0.2, 1.6]
param c = Rel [0.03, 0.28]
param d = Harm [0.8, 2.4]
param e = Tone [1800, 8000]
param f = Level [0.8, 1.3]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.035
env2: type = rms; attack = 0.012; release = c
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.16
stage1: y = x * (1 + env1 * a) / (1 + env2 * b * 0.55)
stage2: y = tube(y, d)
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = e; q = 0.7; gain = 2.2
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y * f, 1.1), 0.86)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 13000; resonance = 0.18

name: Zatox Screamer
description: Hardstyle screaming lead: swept resonant peak before tube distortion, LFO-driven scream band 300-2400 Hz.
script:
# Zatox Screamer
# Hardstyle screaming lead: swept resonant peak before tube distortion, LFO-driven scream band 300-2400 Hz.
# a Sweep Rate: 0.3 to 2.5, default 0.8
# b Peak Gain: 4 to 12, default 8
# c Dist Drive: 2.5 to 8, default 5.2
# d Peak Range: 800 to 2400, default 1600
# e Tone: 2800 to 7500, default 4200
# f Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 0.85

param a = Sweep Rate [0.3, 2.5]
param b = Peak Gain [4.0, 12.0]
param c = Dist Drive [2.5, 8.0]
param d = Peak Range [800, 2400]
param e = Tone [2800, 7500]
param f = Mix [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.4
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
eq1: type = peak; freq = 800 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * d; q = 6; gain = b
stage1: y = tube(x, c * 0.65)
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = 3800; q = 0.7; gain = 3.2
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(x, 1.8), 0.68)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.35
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1
stage3: y = x * f

name: Hyper Cyberpunk Sweep
description: Breaks/electro: dual bandpass (static + LFO-swept), asymmetric tube+diode, bitcrush on swept path, metallic comb.
script:
# Hyper Cyberpunk Sweep
# Breaks/electro: dual bandpass (static + LFO-swept), asymmetric tube+diode, bitcrush on swept path, metallic comb.
# a Sweep Speed: 0.3 to 1.8, default 0.7
# b Sweep Width: 600 to 2400, default 1600
# c Static Peak: 600 to 1200, default 880
# d Crunch: 6 to 11, default 8.5
# e Comb: 8 to 22, default 14
# f Level: 0.7 to 1.3, default 0.95

param a = Sweep Speed [0.3, 1.8]
param b = Sweep Width [600, 2400]
param c = Static Peak [600, 1200]
param d = Crunch [6.0, 11.0]
param e = Comb [8, 22]
param f = Level [0.7, 1.3]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 95; resonance = 0.45
osc1: shape = triangle; freq = a; depth = 1.0
eq1: type = peak; freq = c; q = 4; gain = 5
eq2: type = peak; freq = 400 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * b; q = 6; gain = 7
stage1: y = tube(x, 3.2)
stage2: y = diode(x, 2.5)
stage3: y = bitcrush(x, d)
delay1: time = e; feedback = 0.34; mix = 0.16; damp = 6800
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7200; resonance = 0.38
stage4: y = x * f

name: Speaking Bass
description: Dubstep talking bass: three formant peaks (120/680/1800 Hz) LFO-modulated simultaneously, soft-then-hard ceiling, clean sub bus.
script:
# Speaking Bass
# Dubstep talking bass: three formant peaks (120/680/1800 Hz) LFO-modulated simultaneously, soft-then-hard ceiling, clean sub bus.
# a Talk Speed: 0.2 to 3, default 0.8
# b Vowel Morph: 0.5 to 2, default 1.2
# c Dirt: 2 to 7, default 4.5
# d Formant Shift: 0.7 to 1.5, default 1
# e Sub Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.8
# f Mix: 0.6 to 1, default 0.85

param a = Talk Speed [0.2, 3.0]
param b = Vowel Morph [0.5, 2.0]
param c = Dirt [2.0, 7.0]
param d = Formant Shift [0.7, 1.5]
param e = Sub Level [0.4, 1.2]
param f = Mix [0.6, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = softclip(x, c * 0.4)  # soft pre-clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 120 * d + osc1 * 80 * b; q = 2; gain = 6  # formant 1
eq2: type = peak; freq = 680 * d + osc1 * 400 * b; q = 6; gain = 7  # formant 2
eq3: type = peak; freq = 1800 * d + osc1 * 600 * b; q = 8; gain = 6  # formant 3
stage2: y = hardclip(y, 0.72)  # hard ceiling
xover1: f1 = 150

bus sub:
  send: in = 1
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.4
  stage3: y = x * e

out: main = f; sub = e

name: Hardstyle Tail Screech
description: Zatox-style hardstyle: envelope-controlled resonance intensity, highpass sweep 800-3200 Hz, tube + hardclip + resonant peak.
script:
# Hardstyle Tail Screech
# Zatox-style hardstyle: envelope-controlled resonance intensity, highpass sweep 800-3200 Hz, tube + hardclip + resonant peak.
# a Scream Thresh: -30 to -10, default -18
# b Peak Freq: 800 to 3200, default 1600
# c Reso Depth: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.5
# d Drive: 3 to 10, default 6.5
# e Comp Ratio: 2 to 8, default 4
# f Output: 0.5 to 1.2, default 0.8

param a = Scream Thresh [-30, -10]
param b = Peak Freq [800, 3200]
param c = Reso Depth [0.2, 0.8]
param d = Drive [3.0, 10.0]
param e = Comp Ratio [2.0, 8.0]
param f = Output [0.5, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.4
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.005; release = 0.18
stage1: y = tube(x, d * 0.6)
stage2: y = hardclip(x, 0.7)
filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.45
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 2.4 + env1 * c * 2; gain = 6
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = e; attack = 0.008; release = 0.12; makeup = 6
stage3: y = x * f

name: Acid Morph 303
description: Classic 303: diode pre-distortion, swept resonant LPF 120-2400 Hz, accent via envelope increases resonance on transients.
script:
# Acid Morph 303
# Classic 303: diode pre-distortion, swept resonant LPF 120-2400 Hz, accent via envelope increases resonance on transients.
# a Cutoff: 120 to 2400, default 800
# b Resonance: 0.6 to 1.25, default 0.95
# c LFO Rate: 0.2 to 4, default 1
# d LFO Depth: 0 to 1, default 0.7
# e Accent: 0 to 1.5, default 0.6
# f Drive: 3 to 12, default 7

param a = Cutoff [120, 2400]
param b = Resonance [0.6, 1.25]
param c = LFO Rate [0.2, 4.0]
param d = LFO Depth [0.0, 1.0]
param e = Accent [0.0, 1.5]
param f = Drive [3.0, 12.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 35; resonance = 0.28
osc1: shape = sine; freq = c; depth = d
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.003; release = 0.15
stage1: y = hardclip(x, 0.85)
stage2: y = diode(x, f * 0.5)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = a + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 1000; resonance = b + env1 * e * 0.15
stage3: y = softclip(x, 1.5)
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08

name: Frequency Assassin
description: Industrial smash: three notch filters with inverse LFO sweeps cut 200-1800 Hz, remaining spectrum through fuzz + fold, rhythmic gate.
script:
# Frequency Assassin
# Industrial smash: three notch filters with inverse LFO sweeps cut 200-1800 Hz, remaining spectrum through fuzz + fold, rhythmic gate.
# a Notch Sweep: 0.3 to 2.5, default 1
# b Notch Width: 3 to 10, default 6
# c Fuzz: 4 to 14, default 9
# d Gate Thresh: -42 to -24, default -32
# e Delay FB: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.45
# f Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 0.8

param a = Notch Sweep [0.3, 2.5]
param b = Notch Width [3.0, 10.0]
param c = Fuzz [4.0, 14.0]
param d = Gate Thresh [-42, -24]
param e = Delay FB [0.2, 0.7]
param f = Mix [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.4
osc1: shape = triangle; freq = a; depth = 1.0
eq1: type = notch; freq = 500 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 400; q = b; gain = 0
eq2: type = notch; freq = 1100 + (0.5 - 0.5 * osc1) * 400; q = b; gain = 0
eq3: type = notch; freq = 1700 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 400; q = b; gain = 0
stage1: y = tube(x, c * 0.4)
stage2: y = tube(x, c * 0.5)
stage3: y = fold(x, -0.4, 0.5)
gate1: threshold = d; hyst = 6; hold = 0.04; range = -18
delay1: sync = 1/16; feedback = e; mix = 0.22; damp = 5000; pingpong = true
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7200; resonance = 0.35
comp1: threshold = -16; ratio = 6; attack = 0.005; release = 0.1; makeup = 4
stage4: y = x * f

name: CTZ Kick Master
description: Hardstyle/hardcore clip-to-zero: transient hard-clip 0.72, 3-band split (sub clean, mid soft-clip, high hard-clip), minimal final limiter.
script:
# CTZ Kick Master
# Hardstyle/hardcore clip-to-zero: transient hard-clip 0.72, 3-band split (sub clean, mid soft-clip, high hard-clip), minimal final limiter.
# a Transient Clip: 0.65 to 0.85, default 0.72
# b Mid Drive: 1.5 to 3.5, default 2.5
# c High Ceiling: 0.75 to 0.95, default 0.85
# d Soft Glue: 1.2 to 2.2, default 1.8
# e Final Limit: -0.3 to -0.05, default -0.1
# f Output: 0.8 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Transient Clip [0.65, 0.85]
param b = Mid Drive [1.5, 3.5]
param c = High Ceiling [0.75, 0.95]
param d = Soft Glue [1.2, 2.2]
param e = Final Limit [-0.3, -0.05]
param f = Output [0.8, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 25; resonance = 0.25
stage1: y = hardclip(x, a)
xover1: f1 = 80; f2 = 3000
bus low:
  stage2: y = softclip(x, d)
  limit1: ceiling = e; release = 0.08
  stage7: y = x * f
bus mid:
  stage3: y = softclip(x, b)
  stage5: y = softclip(x, d)
  limit2: ceiling = e; release = 0.08
  stage8: y = x * f
bus high:
  stage4: y = hardclip(x, c)
  stage6: y = softclip(x, d)
  limit3: ceiling = e; release = 0.08
  stage9: y = x * f
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: Loudness Wall
description: Club mastering: four-stage clipping cascade (source clip + tube + multiband soft-clip + master soft + limiter), 8× OS recommended.
script:
# Loudness Wall
# Club mastering: four-stage clipping cascade (source clip + tube + multiband soft-clip + master soft + limiter), 8× OS recommended.
# a Source Clip: 0.82 to 0.95, default 0.88
# b Soft Drive: 1.2 to 2, default 1.5
# c Band Drive: 1.3 to 2.5, default 1.8
# d Master Glue: 1 to 1.6, default 1.2
# e Limiter: -0.3 to -0.1, default -0.2
# f Makeup: 0.9 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Source Clip [0.82, 0.95]
param b = Soft Drive [1.2, 2.0]
param c = Band Drive [1.3, 2.5]
param d = Master Glue [1.0, 1.6]
param e = Limiter [-0.3, -0.1]
param f = Makeup [0.9, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.22
stage1: y = hardclip(x, a)
stage2: y = tube(x, b)
xover1: f1 = 120; f2 = 3000
bus low:
  stage3: y = softclip(x, 1.3)
  stage6: y = softclip(x, d)
  limit1: ceiling = e; release = 0.1
  stage8: y = x * f
bus mid:
  stage4: y = softclip(x, c)
  stage7: y = softclip(x, d)
  limit2: ceiling = e; release = 0.1
  stage9: y = x * f
bus high:
  stage5: y = softclip(x, 1.4)
  stage10: y = softclip(x, d)
  limit3: ceiling = e; release = 0.1
  stage11: y = x * f
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: Brickwall Techno
description: Schranz/techno: aggressive per-band limiting (low compress 8:1, mid tube+hard, high transient clip), merge then glue comp + limiter.
script:
# Brickwall Techno
# Schranz/techno: aggressive per-band limiting (low compress 8:1, mid tube+hard, high transient clip), merge then glue comp + limiter.
# a Low Comp: 6 to 12, default 8
# b Mid Drive: 3 to 6, default 4
# c High Clip: 0.65 to 0.85, default 0.75
# d Glue: 2 to 5, default 3
# e Limiter: -0.25 to -0.1, default -0.15
# f Output: 0.85 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Low Comp [6.0, 12.0]
param b = Mid Drive [3.0, 6.0]
param c = High Clip [0.65, 0.85]
param d = Glue [2.0, 5.0]
param e = Limiter [-0.25, -0.1]
param f = Output [0.85, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 28; resonance = 0.25
xover1: f1 = 120; f2 = 4000
bus low:
  comp1: threshold = -22; ratio = a; attack = 0.01; release = 0.15; makeup = 8
  stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, 1.4), 0.6)
  comp4: threshold = -8; ratio = d; attack = 0.002; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  limit1: ceiling = e; release = 0.1
  stage6: y = x * f
bus mid:
  stage2: y = tube(x, b)
  stage3: y = hardclip(x, 0.55)
  comp2: threshold = -8; ratio = d; attack = 0.002; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  limit2: ceiling = e; release = 0.1
  stage7: y = x * f
bus high:
  stage4: y = hardclip(x, c)
  stage5: y = softclip(x, 1.5)
  comp3: threshold = -8; ratio = d; attack = 0.002; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  limit3: ceiling = e; release = 0.1
  stage8: y = x * f
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: Master Bus Destroyer
description: Industrial/club: parallel distortion (clean 60-85% + slammed 15-40%), OTT density, final limiter with stereo widener before.
script:
# Master Bus Destroyer
# Industrial/club: parallel distortion (clean 60-85% + slammed 15-40%), OTT density, final limiter with stereo widener before.
# a Slam Drive: 4 to 8, default 6
# b Slam Mix: 0.15 to 0.4, default 0.25
# c OTT Amount: 0.3 to 0.8, default 0.5
# d Width: 0.8 to 1.1, default 0.95
# e Limiter: -0.3 to -0.15, default -0.2
# f Output: 0.9 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Slam Drive [4.0, 8.0]
param b = Slam Mix [0.15, 0.4]
param c = OTT Amount [0.3, 0.8]
param d = Width [0.8, 1.1]
param e = Limiter [-0.3, -0.15]
param f = Output [0.9, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.25
bus clean:
  send: in = 1
  stage1: y = x
  ott1: depth = c; time = 0.015
  widen1: width = d; delay = 12; bass = 120
  limit1: ceiling = e; release = 0.1
  stage5: y = x * f
bus slammed:
  send: in = 1
  filter2: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.35
  stage2: y = tube(x, a)
  stage3: y = hardclip(x, 0.45)
  stage4: y = softclip(x, 2.2)
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.3
  ott2: depth = c; time = 0.015
  widen2: width = d; delay = 12; bass = 120
  limit2: ceiling = e; release = 0.1
  stage6: y = x * f
out: clean = 1-b; slammed = b

name: rekkt Midtempo Pump
description: Midtempo 110-130 BPM: triangle LFO (1/8 sync) modulates filter cutoff/reso/drive, asymmetric fold, noise injection, counter-pump sidechain.
script:
# rekkt Midtempo Pump
# Midtempo 110-130 BPM: triangle LFO (1/8 sync) modulates filter cutoff/reso/drive, asymmetric fold, noise injection, counter-pump sidechain.
# a LFO Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.5
# b Filter Depth: 1000 to 4000, default 2500
# c Reso Depth: 0.5 to 2.5, default 1.5
# d Drive Depth: 2 to 5, default 3.5
# e Noise: 0.05 to 0.2, default 0.1
# f Pump: 2 to 8, default 4

param a = LFO Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Filter Depth [1000, 4000]
param c = Reso Depth [0.5, 2.5]
param d = Drive Depth [2.0, 5.0]
param e = Noise [0.05, 0.2]
param f = Pump [2.0, 8.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35
osc1: shape = triangle; sync = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (1 - e) + x * e * 1.15
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 300 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * b; resonance = 0.4 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c
stage2: y = tube(x, 1.5 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * d)
stage3: y = fold(x, -0.35, 0.45)
comp1: threshold = -14; ratio = f; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 4
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7500; resonance = 0.28
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.1

name: zerosum Chaos Grid
description: Experimental glitch: S&H square LFO drives random filter jumps, stepped bitcrush modulation, feedback-modulated delay, asymmetric fold + gate.
script:
# zerosum Chaos Grid
# Experimental glitch: S&H square LFO drives random filter jumps, stepped bitcrush modulation, feedback-modulated delay, asymmetric fold + gate.
# a Chaos Rate: 4 to 18, default 9
# b Crush Depth: 4 to 10, default 7
# c Fold Asym: 0.3 to 0.8, default 0.5
# d Delay Chaos: 0.2 to 1.5, default 0.6
# e Gate Thresh: -42 to -30, default -38
# f Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 0.8

param a = Chaos Rate [4.0, 18.0]
param b = Crush Depth [4.0, 10.0]
param c = Fold Asym [0.3, 0.8]
param d = Delay Chaos [0.2, 1.5]
param e = Gate Thresh [-42, -30]
param f = Mix [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.4
osc1: shape = square; freq = a; depth = 1.0
osc2: shape = triangle; freq = d; depth = 1.0
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 400 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 3000; resonance = 0.85
stage1: y = bitcrush(x, b + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 3)
delay1: time = 80; feedback = 0.4 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2) * 0.25; mix = 0.35; damp = 5000
stage2: y = fold(x, -0.2 * c, 0.6 * c)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6800; resonance = 0.32
gate1: threshold = e; hyst = 6; hold = 0.06; range = -18; attack = 0.001; release = 0.06
stage3: y = x * f

name: Pulsing Electro
description: Electro/breaks: dual LFOs (sine 1/4 smooth pump + saw 1/16 stutter), filter/drive modulated, rhythmic hardclip ceiling, noise injection, glue comp.
script:
# Pulsing Electro
# Electro/breaks: dual LFOs (sine 1/4 smooth pump + saw 1/16 stutter), filter/drive modulated, rhythmic hardclip ceiling, noise injection, glue comp.
# a Pump Speed: 0 to 1, default 0.5
# b Stutter Speed: 0 to 1, default 0.5
# c Filter Range: 1200 to 4000, default 2400
# d Drive Range: 1.5 to 5, default 3
# e Noise: 0.08 to 0.18, default 0.12
# f Glue: 2 to 5, default 3

param a = Pump Speed [1/2, 1/8]
param b = Stutter Speed [1/8, 1/32]
param c = Filter Range [1200, 4000]
param d = Drive Range [1.5, 5.0]
param e = Noise [0.08, 0.18]
param f = Glue [2.0, 5.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 75; resonance = 0.38
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0
osc2: shape = saw; sync = b; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (1 - e) + x * e * 1.2
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 400 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c; resonance = 0.6
stage2: y = tube(x, 1 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * d)
stage3: y = hardclip(x, 0.45 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2) * 0.4)
comp1: threshold = -14; ratio = f; attack = 0.005; release = 0.12; makeup = 3
limit1: ceiling = -0.25; release = 0.09

name: Vital Saw Morph
description: Synthwave/future bass: asymmetric saw via fold+tube, phase dispersion dual delay, triangle LFO sweeps highshelf, chorus width, light comp.
script:
# Vital Saw Morph
# Synthwave/future bass: asymmetric saw via fold+tube, phase dispersion dual delay, triangle LFO sweeps highshelf, chorus width, light comp.
# a Morph LFO: 0.4 to 2.5, default 1.2
# b Phase Spread: 3 to 7, default 5
# c Shelf Sweep: -6 to 6, default 0
# d Chorus: 0.15 to 0.4, default 0.25
# e Width: 0.6 to 1.2, default 0.9
# f Level: 0.7 to 1.2, default 0.95

param a = Morph LFO [0.4, 2.5]
param b = Phase Spread [3.0, 7.0]
param c = Shelf Sweep [-6, 6]
param d = Chorus [0.15, 0.4]
param e = Width [0.6, 1.2]
param f = Level [0.7, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 60; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = fold(x, -0.5, 0.6)  # asymmetric fold
stage2: y = tube(x, 2.2)  # tube shape
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0; mix = 0.35; channel = left  # phase L
delay2: time = b * 1.4; feedback = 0; mix = 0.35; channel = right  # phase R
stage3: channel = right; y = x * -1  # invert R
osc1: shape = triangle; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 2800; q = 0.7; gain = c + osc1 * 6  # swept shelf
delay3: time = 8; feedback = 0.2; mix = d; damp = 6500  # chorus
widen1: width = e; delay = 14; bass = 130
comp1: threshold = -16; ratio = 2; attack = 0.01; release = 0.15; makeup = 2
stage4: y = x * f

name: Hard Groove Machine
description: Hard dance/hardstyle: square LFO (1/8 sync) gates signal on/off, tube+resonant bandpass when open, reverb tail when closed, transient punch.
script:
# Hard Groove Machine
# Hard dance/hardstyle: square LFO (1/8 sync) gates signal on/off, tube+resonant bandpass when open, reverb tail when closed, transient punch.
# a Gate Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.5
# b Drive: 3 to 8, default 5.5
# c Filter Freq: 800 to 2400, default 1400
# d Reso: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.7
# e Tail: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.4
# f Punch: 0 to 6, default 3

param a = Gate Rate [1/4, 1/16]
param b = Drive [3.0, 8.0]
param c = Filter Freq [800, 2400]
param d = Reso [0.4, 1.2]
param e = Tail [0.2, 0.6]
param f = Punch [0.0, 6.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 75; resonance = 0.4
osc1: shape = square; sync = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (0.22 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 0.78)
stage2: y = tube(x, b)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = d
reverb1: size = 0.4; decay = e; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.22 * (1 - 0.5 * osc1)
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.003; release = 0.12
stage3: y = x * (1 + env1 * f * 0.15)
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1

name: Resonant Sweep Stab
description: Trance/hard trance: envelope follower controls filter cutoff 150-4500 Hz, LFO saw adds sweep, velocity-sensitive resonance Q 0.7-5.5, stereo widener.
script:
# Resonant Sweep Stab
# Trance/hard trance: envelope follower controls filter cutoff 150-4500 Hz, LFO saw adds sweep, velocity-sensitive resonance Q 0.7-5.5, stereo widener.
# a Env Amount: 0.3 to 1.2, default 0.8
# b LFO Amount: 0 to 1, default 0.5
# c Reso Env: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4
# d Drive: 2 to 6, default 3.5
# e Width: 0.5 to 1.2, default 0.9
# f Mix: 0.6 to 1, default 0.85

param a = Env Amount [0.3, 1.2]
param b = LFO Amount [0.0, 1.0]
param c = Reso Env [0.2, 0.7]
param d = Drive [2.0, 6.0]
param e = Width [0.5, 1.2]
param f = Mix [0.6, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.35
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.008; release = 0.25
osc1: shape = saw; sync = 1/4; depth = b
stage1: y = softclip(x, d * 0.8)
stage2: y = hardclip(x, 0.75)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 250 + env1 * 3500 * a + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 800; resonance = 0.45 + env1 * c
comp1: threshold = -16; ratio = 4; attack = 0.005; release = 0.15; makeup = 4
widen1: width = e; delay = 16; bass = 120
limit1: ceiling = -0.35; release = 0.1
stage3: y = x * f

name: Kick Surgery
description: Hardstyle/rawstyle kick: 3-band crossover (sub sine+comp, punch tube+320Hz notch, click transient+air shelf), phase-aligned merge, final limiter -0.3dB.
script:
# Kick Surgery
# Hardstyle/rawstyle kick: 3-band crossover (sub sine+comp, punch tube+320Hz notch, click transient+air shelf), phase-aligned merge, final limiter -0.3dB.
# a Sub Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.8
# b Punch Drive: 1.5 to 5, default 3
# c Click Bright: 0 to 4, default 2
# d Scoop Depth: -6 to -1, default -4
# e Glue Comp: 2 to 6, default 4
# f Mix: 0.7 to 1, default 0.9

param a = Sub Level [0.4, 1.2]
param b = Punch Drive [1.5, 5.0]
param c = Click Bright [0.0, 4.0]
param d = Scoop Depth [-6, -1]
param e = Glue Comp [2.0, 6.0]
param f = Mix [0.7, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 20; resonance = 0.25
bus sub:
  send: in = 1
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.2
  stage1: y = tanh(x)
  comp1: threshold = -18; ratio = 4; attack = 0.01; release = 0.15; makeup = 4
  stage2: y = x * a
  comp4: threshold = -12; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08
  stage5: y = x * f
bus punch:
  send: in = 1
  filter3: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.22
  filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 650; resonance = 0.22
  stage3: y = tube(x, b)
  eq1: type = peak; freq = 320; q = 2.8; gain = d
  comp2: threshold = -12; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  limit2: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08
  stage6: y = x * f
bus click:
  send: in = 1
  filter5: type = highpass; cutoff = 650; resonance = 0.22
  env1: type = peak; attack = 0.002; release = 0.08
  stage4: y = x * (1 + env1 * 0.4)
  eq2: type = highshelf; freq = 6000; q = 0.7; gain = c
  comp3: threshold = -12; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  limit3: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08
  stage7: y = x * f
out: main = 0; sub = 1; punch = 1; click = 1

name: Sub Zero Pummel
description: Sub Zero Project hardstyle: dual-path (main HPF 95Hz mid-focus, sub bus LPF 100Hz phase-aligned), sub heavy comp 8:1, parallel OTT, sidechain duck.
script:
# Sub Zero Pummel
# Sub Zero Project hardstyle: dual-path (main HPF 95Hz mid-focus, sub bus LPF 100Hz phase-aligned), sub heavy comp 8:1, parallel OTT, sidechain duck.
# a Sub Comp: 6 to 12, default 8
# b Sub Phase: -180 to 180, default 0
# c OTT Drive: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4
# d Main Punch: 1.5 to 4, default 2.5
# e Sidechain: 2 to 8, default 4
# f Balance: 0.5 to 1.2, default 0.85

param a = Sub Comp [6.0, 12.0]
param b = Sub Phase [-180, 180]
param c = OTT Drive [0.2, 0.7]
param d = Main Punch [1.5, 4.0]
param e = Sidechain [2.0, 8.0]
param f = Balance [0.5, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 95; resonance = 0.4
stage1: y = softclip(x, d)
ott1: depth = c; time = 0.015
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.1
bus sub:
  send: in = 1
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.45
  stage2: y = tanh(x * 1.2)
  comp1: threshold = -24; ratio = a; attack = 0.015; release = 0.18; makeup = 10
  comp2: source = sidechain; threshold = -18; ratio = e; attack = 0.002; release = 0.06
  stage3: y = x * f
  delay1: time = 0.05 + abs(b) / 180 * 2; feedback = 0; mix = 1
  limit2: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.1
out: main = 1; sub = 1

name: Priest Split Authority
description: Holypriest hardcore: amplitude split (quiet<-18dB reverb+chorus, medium -18to-6dB tube, loud>-6dB brick+transient), crossfade recombine.
script:
# Priest Split Authority
# Holypriest hardcore: amplitude split (quiet<-18dB reverb+chorus, medium -18to-6dB tube, loud>-6dB brick+transient), crossfade recombine.
# a Quiet Verb: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.5
# b Mid Drive: 2 to 6, default 4
# c Loud Clip: 0.45 to 0.75, default 0.6
# d Transient: 0 to 6, default 3
# e Blend: 0.5 to 1, default 0.75
# f Output: 0.8 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Quiet Verb [0.3, 0.7]
param b = Mid Drive [2.0, 6.0]
param c = Loud Clip [0.45, 0.75]
param d = Transient [0.0, 6.0]
param e = Blend [0.5, 1.0]
param f = Output [0.8, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.25
bus quiet:
  send: in = 1
  gate1: threshold = -18; hyst = 6; hold = 0.08; range = -12; attack = 0.02; release = 0.15
  reverb1: size = 0.6; decay = a; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.6
  delay1: time = 6; feedback = 0.2; mix = 0.3; damp = 7000
  stage4: y = x * f
bus medium:
  send: in = 1
  gate2: threshold = -18; hyst = 12; hold = 0.04; range = -6; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08
  stage1: y = tube(x, b)
  stage5: y = x * f
bus loud:
  send: in = 1
  gate3: threshold = -6; hyst = 6; hold = 0.02; range = -80; attack = 0.001; release = 0.05
  stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(x, 2.5), c)
  filter6: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11000; resonance = 0.22
  env2: type = peak; attack = 0.002; release = 0.06
  stage3: y = x * (1 + env2 * d * 0.15)
  stage6: y = x * f
out: quiet = 0.3; medium = 0.5; loud = e

name: Multiband Phase Lock
description: Club/techno: 4-band split (sub 30-80Hz, low 80-250Hz, mid 250-2500Hz, high 2500+Hz), independent matched comp, soft-limit all to -0.5dB, merge.
script:
# Multiband Phase Lock
# Club/techno: 4-band split (sub 30-80Hz, low 80-250Hz, mid 250-2500Hz, high 2500+Hz), independent matched comp, soft-limit all to -0.5dB, merge.
# a Sub Comp: 8 to 12, default 10
# b Low Comp: 3 to 6, default 4
# c Mid Comp: 2 to 4, default 3
# d High Comp: 1.5 to 3, default 2
# e Master Comp: 2 to 5, default 3
# f Makeup: 0.9 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Sub Comp [8.0, 12.0]
param b = Low Comp [3.0, 6.0]
param c = Mid Comp [2.0, 4.0]
param d = High Comp [1.5, 3.0]
param e = Master Comp [2.0, 5.0]
param f = Makeup [0.9, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.22
bus sub:
  send: in = 1
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.18
  comp1: threshold = -20; ratio = a; attack = 0.02; release = 0.2; makeup = 8
  stage1: y = hardclip(x, 0.5)
  comp5: threshold = -10; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  stage5: y = x * f
bus low:
  send: in = 1
  filter3: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.18
  filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 250; resonance = 0.18
  comp2: threshold = -16; ratio = b; attack = 0.01; release = 0.15; makeup = 5
  stage2: y = hardclip(x, 0.5)
  comp6: threshold = -10; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  stage6: y = x * f
bus mid:
  send: in = 1
  filter5: type = highpass; cutoff = 250; resonance = 0.18
  filter6: type = lowpass; cutoff = 2500; resonance = 0.18
  comp3: threshold = -12; ratio = c; attack = 0.008; release = 0.1; makeup = 3
  stage3: y = hardclip(x, 0.5)
  comp7: threshold = -10; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  stage7: y = x * f
bus high:
  send: in = 1
  filter7: type = highpass; cutoff = 2500; resonance = 0.18
  comp4: threshold = -8; ratio = d; attack = 0.005; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  stage4: y = hardclip(x, 0.5)
  comp8: threshold = -10; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  stage8: y = x * f
out: main = 0; sub = 1; low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: Bass Fractionator
description: Neurofunk/DnB: sub pure sine phase-locked, body 100-400Hz formant filter, grit 400-1200Hz bitcrush+fold, air 1200+Hz transient, envelope alignment.
script:
# Bass Fractionator
# Neurofunk/DnB: sub pure sine phase-locked, body 100-400Hz formant filter, grit 400-1200Hz bitcrush+fold, air 1200+Hz transient, envelope alignment.
# a Sub Sync: 0 to 1, default 0.8
# b Body Formant: 150 to 350, default 220
# c Grit Bits: 5 to 10, default 7
# d Air Transient: 0 to 5, default 3
# e Band Balance: 0.5 to 1.2, default 0.85
# f Mix: 0.6 to 1, default 0.85

param a = Sub Sync [0.0, 1.0]
param b = Body Formant [150, 350]
param c = Grit Bits [5.0, 10.0]
param d = Air Transient [0.0, 5.0]
param e = Band Balance [0.5, 1.2]
param f = Mix [0.6, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.25
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.003; release = 0.12
bus sub:
  send: in = 1
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.2
  stage1: y = tanh(x * 1.5)
  stage2: y = x * (0.3 + env1 * a * 0.7)
  limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08
  stage7: y = x * f
bus body:
  send: in = 1
  filter3: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.2
  filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 400; resonance = 0.2
  eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 4; gain = 6
  eq2: type = peak; freq = b * 2.8; q = 5; gain = 5
  stage3: y = tube(x, 2.5)
  limit2: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08
  stage8: y = x * f
bus grit:
  send: in = 1
  filter5: type = highpass; cutoff = 400; resonance = 0.2
  filter6: type = lowpass; cutoff = 1200; resonance = 0.2
  stage4: y = bitcrush(x, c)
  stage5: y = fold(x, -0.35, 0.4)
  filter8: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.35
  limit3: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08
  stage9: y = x * e * f
bus air:
  send: in = 1
  filter7: type = highpass; cutoff = 1200; resonance = 0.2
  env2: type = peak; attack = 0.002; release = 0.05
  stage6: y = x * (1 + env2 * d * 0.2)
  eq3: type = highshelf; freq = 4000; q = 0.7; gain = 3
  limit4: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08
  stage10: y = x * f
out: main = 0; sub = 1; body = 1; grit = 1; air = 1

name: Surgical Snare Designer
description: Multiband transient shaper: 3-band xover (low sustain cut 200-300Hz, mid 300-1500Hz snap boost, high 1500+Hz air), envelope per band, glue comp.
script:
# Surgical Snare Designer
# Multiband transient shaper: 3-band xover (low sustain cut 200-300Hz, mid 300-1500Hz snap boost, high 1500+Hz air), envelope per band, glue comp.
# a Low Sustain: 0.1 to 0.6, default 0.35
# b Mid Attack: 0 to 6, default 3
# c High Air: 0 to 4, default 2
# d Snap Time: 0.02 to 0.15, default 0.06
# e Glue: 2 to 5, default 3
# f Output: 0.8 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Low Sustain [0.1, 0.6]
param b = Mid Attack [0.0, 6.0]
param c = High Air [0.0, 4.0]
param d = Snap Time [0.02, 0.15]
param e = Glue [2.0, 5.0]
param f = Output [0.8, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.28
xover1: f1 = 250; f2 = 1500
bus low:
  env1: type = rms; attack = 0.01; release = 0.12
  gate1: threshold = -24; hyst = 6; hold = 0.05; range = -18; attack = 0.005; release = 0.2
  stage1: y = x * a * (0.45 + env1)
  comp1: threshold = -14; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  stage3: y = x * f
bus mid:
  env2: type = peak; attack = 0.002; release = d
  stage2: y = x * (1 + env2 * b * 0.15)
  comp2: threshold = -14; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  stage4: y = x * f
bus high:
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4500; q = 0.7; gain = c
  comp3: threshold = -14; ratio = e; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2
  stage5: y = x * f
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: Depth Sculptor
description: Psychoacoustic depth: 2-band xover 400Hz (low immediate, high delayed 5-25ms for 3D layback), crossfeed, soft reverb, slight detuning via chorus.
script:
# Depth Sculptor
# Psychoacoustic depth: 2-band xover 400Hz (low immediate, high delayed 5-25ms for 3D layback), crossfeed, soft reverb, slight detuning via chorus.
# a Delay Depth: 5 to 25, default 15
# b Crossfeed: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.4
# c Reverb: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3
# d Detune: 0.15 to 0.35, default 0.25
# e Width: 0.7 to 1.2, default 0.95
# f Mix: 0.6 to 1, default 0.85

param a = Delay Depth [5.0, 25.0]
param b = Crossfeed [0.2, 0.6]
param c = Reverb [0.15, 0.5]
param d = Detune [0.15, 0.35]
param e = Width [0.7, 1.2]
param f = Mix [0.6, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.3
xover1: f1 = 400
bus low:
  limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1
  stage3: y = x * f
bus high:
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0; mix = 1
  delay2: time = 2; feedback = 0; mix = b; pingpong = true
  reverb1: size = 0.5; decay = 0.35; damp = 0.6; mix = c
  delay4: time = 7; feedback = 0.18; mix = d; damp = 7500
  widen1: width = e; delay = 12; bass = 150
  limit2: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1
  stage4: y = x * f
out: low = 1; high = 1

name: Multiband Punch Enhancer
description: Master bus: 4-band transient processing (sub sub-bass tight, low punch boost, mid clarity, high sparkle), OTT gentle drive, soft limiter -0.3dB.
script:
# Multiband Punch Enhancer
# Master bus: 4-band transient processing (sub sub-bass tight, low punch boost, mid clarity, high sparkle), OTT gentle drive, soft limiter -0.3dB.
# a Sub Tight: 0 to 4, default 2
# b Low Punch: 0 to 5, default 3
# c Mid Clarity: 0 to 4, default 2
# d High Sparkle: 0 to 3, default 1.5
# e OTT Drive: 0.2 to 0.5, default 0.35
# f Master: 0.9 to 1.1, default 1

param a = Sub Tight [0.0, 4.0]
param b = Low Punch [0.0, 5.0]
param c = Mid Clarity [0.0, 4.0]
param d = High Sparkle [0.0, 3.0]
param e = OTT Drive [0.2, 0.5]
param f = Master [0.9, 1.1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 20; resonance = 0.22
xover1: f1 = 90; f2 = 3000
bus low:
  env1: type = peak; attack = 0.005; release = 0.08
  stage1: y = x * (1 + env1 * a * 0.1)
  env2: type = peak; attack = 0.003; release = 0.1
  stage2: y = x * (1 + env2 * b * 0.12)
  ott1: depth = e; time = 0.02
  limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.12
  stage5: y = x * f
bus mid:
  env3: type = peak; attack = 0.002; release = 0.06
  stage3: y = x * (1 + env3 * c * 0.1)
  ott2: depth = e; time = 0.02
  limit2: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.12
  stage6: y = x * f
bus high:
  env4: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = 0.04
  stage4: y = x * (1 + env4 * d * 0.08)
  ott3: depth = e; time = 0.02
  limit3: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.12
  stage7: y = x * f
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: Dynamic Space Former
description: Ambient/pads: 3-band envelope-based expansion (low slow bloom, mid fast decay, high shimmer tail), hall reverb, soft chorus, gentle comp.
script:
# Dynamic Space Former
# Ambient/pads: 3-band envelope-based expansion (low slow bloom, mid fast decay, high shimmer tail), hall reverb, soft chorus, gentle comp.
# a Low Bloom: 0.25 to 0.6, default 0.4
# b Mid Decay: 0.1 to 0.3, default 0.2
# c High Shimmer: 0.4 to 0.8, default 0.6
# d Verb Size: 0.6 to 0.95, default 0.8
# e Chorus: 0.2 to 0.5, default 0.35
# f Mix: 0.7 to 1, default 0.9

param a = Low Bloom [0.25, 0.6]
param b = Mid Decay [0.1, 0.3]
param c = High Shimmer [0.4, 0.8]
param d = Verb Size [0.6, 0.95]
param e = Chorus [0.2, 0.5]
param f = Mix [0.7, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 35; resonance = 0.28
xover1: f1 = 250; f2 = 2500
bus low:
  env1: type = rms; attack = 0.05; release = a
  stage1: y = x * (0.7 + env1 * 0.5)
  limit1: ceiling = -0.5; release = 0.15
  stage4: y = x * f
bus mid:
  env2: type = rms; attack = 0.01; release = b
  stage2: y = x * (0.8 + env2 * 0.4)
  limit2: ceiling = -0.5; release = 0.15
  stage5: y = x * f
bus high:
  env3: type = peak; attack = 0.005; release = c
  stage3: y = x * (0.5 + env3 * 0.8)
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 5000; q = 0.7; gain = 2
  reverb1: size = d; decay = 0.7; damp = 0.3; mix = 0.5
  delay1: time = 8; feedback = 0.25; mix = e; damp = 7000
  comp1: threshold = -20; ratio = 1.5; attack = 0.05; release = 0.3; makeup = 1
  limit3: ceiling = -0.5; release = 0.15
  stage6: y = x * f
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1

name: Metal Percussion
description: SWARM industrial percussion: bitcrush transients only, metallic comb delays (59Hz, 83Hz), resonant peak 1200Hz, envelope-based fold, HPF, limiter.
script:
# Metal Percussion
# SWARM industrial percussion: bitcrush transients only, metallic comb delays (59Hz, 83Hz), resonant peak 1200Hz, envelope-based fold, HPF, limiter.
# a Bits: 3 to 8, default 5
# b Comb Mix: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.5
# c Metallic: 2 to 6, default 4
# d Fold Env: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.5
# e Tightness: 0.05 to 0.2, default 0.1
# f Output: 0.8 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Bits [3.0, 8.0]
param b = Comb Mix [0.3, 0.7]
param c = Metallic [2.0, 6.0]
param d = Fold Env [0.2, 0.8]
param e = Tightness [0.05, 0.2]
param f = Output [0.8, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.35
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = e
stage1: y = bitcrush(x * (0.45 + env1), a)
delay1: time = 16.95; feedback = 0.32; mix = b; damp = 4500
delay2: time = 12.05; feedback = 0.28; mix = b * 0.7; damp = 4500
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1200; q = 5; gain = c
stage2: y = fold(x, -0.3 - env1 * d, 0.35 + env1 * d)
comp1: threshold = -12; ratio = 4; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 4
limit1: ceiling = -0.35; release = 0.1
stage3: y = x * f

name: Field Recording Glitch
description: Granular-approximation: 6 parallel short delays 15-85ms with random feedback 0.2-0.5, slight pitch detune -3 to +5 semitones, LPF 7500Hz, reverb tail.
script:
# Field Recording Glitch
# Granular-approximation: 6 parallel short delays 15-85ms with random feedback 0.2-0.5, slight pitch detune -3 to +5 semitones, LPF 7500Hz, reverb tail.
# a Grain Size: 15 to 85, default 45
# b Density: 0.3 to 0.8, default 0.55
# c Pitch Chaos: 0 to 8, default 4
# d Tail: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.5
# e Damp: 0.3 to 0.8, default 0.6
# f Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 0.75

param a = Grain Size [15.0, 85.0]
param b = Density [0.3, 0.8]
param c = Pitch Chaos [0.0, 8.0]
param d = Tail [0.3, 0.7]
param e = Damp [0.3, 0.8]
param f = Mix [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.3
pitch1: shift = -3 + c * 0.5; mix = 0.22
pitch2: shift = 2 + c * 0.38; mix = 0.18
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7500; resonance = 0.4
reverb1: size = 0.65; decay = d; damp = e; mix = 0.28
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.12
stage1: y = x * (0.7 + 0.5 * f)
bus g1:
  send: in = 1
  delay1: time = a * 0.8; feedback = 0.22; mix = 1; damp = 6500
bus g2:
  send: in = 1
  delay2: time = a * 1.1; feedback = 0.35; mix = 1; damp = 6500
bus g3:
  send: in = 1
  delay3: time = a * 0.65; feedback = 0.28; mix = 1; damp = 6500
out: main = 1; g1 = b * 0.45; g2 = b * 0.4; g3 = b * 0.35

name: Downtuned Guitar Industrial
description: DJ Hyper 8-string downtuned guitar: HPF 82Hz (low E), heavy comp 8:1, tube+fold chain, resonant 150Hz body, soft-limit -0.45dB. (IR optional in user path)
script:
# Downtuned Guitar Industrial
# DJ Hyper 8-string downtuned guitar: HPF 82Hz (low E), heavy comp 8:1, tube+fold chain, resonant 150Hz body, soft-limit -0.45dB. (IR optional in user path)
# a Body Reso: 120 to 200, default 150
# b Comp Ratio: 6 to 12, default 8
# c Tube Drive: 3 to 8, default 5.5
# d Fold Amount: 0.3 to 0.8, default 0.55
# e Presence: -2 to 4, default 1
# f Output: 0.8 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Body Reso [120, 200]
param b = Comp Ratio [6.0, 12.0]
param c = Tube Drive [3.0, 8.0]
param d = Fold Amount [0.3, 0.8]
param e = Presence [-2, 4]
param f = Output [0.8, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 82; resonance = 0.4  # downtuned E
comp1: threshold = -20; ratio = b; attack = 0.008; release = 0.12; makeup = 8  # heavy comp
eq1: type = peak; freq = a; q = 4; gain = 5  # body resonance
stage1: y = tube(x, c)
stage2: y = fold(x, -d, d)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.35  # LPF
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = 3000; q = 0.8; gain = e  # presence
comp2: threshold = -10; ratio = 3; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 2  # glue
limit1: ceiling = -0.45; release = 0.1
stage3: y = x * f
# Note: User can insert IR block for cabinet simulation

name: Chaotic Stab Generator
description: Techno chaos stab: random pitch shifts -7 to +7 semitones via dual pitch blocks, resonant BP sweep 400-2400Hz LFO, fold+bitcrush 6-bit, gate, limiter.
script:
# Chaotic Stab Generator
# Techno chaos stab: random pitch shifts -7 to +7 semitones via dual pitch blocks, resonant BP sweep 400-2400Hz LFO, fold+bitcrush 6-bit, gate, limiter.
# a Pitch Chaos: 0 to 7, default 4
# b Sweep Rate: 0.5 to 3, default 1.5
# c Reso: 0.4 to 1.1, default 0.75
# d Fold: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.5
# e Bits: 4 to 8, default 6
# f Mix: 0.6 to 1, default 0.8

param a = Pitch Chaos [0.0, 7.0]
param b = Sweep Rate [0.5, 3.0]
param c = Reso [0.4, 1.1]
param d = Fold [0.3, 0.7]
param e = Bits [4.0, 8.0]
param f = Mix [0.6, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.35
pitch1: shift = -a; mix = 0.22
pitch2: shift = a; mix = 0.18
osc1: shape = triangle; freq = b; depth = 1.0
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 900 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 2400; resonance = c
stage1: y = fold(x, -d, d)
stage2: y = bitcrush(x, e)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7000; resonance = 0.35
comp1: threshold = -12; ratio = 4; attack = 0.005; release = 0.1; makeup = 3
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1
stage3: y = x * f

name: Granular Smear
description: Ambient granular texture: 6 parallel delays 25-150ms detune -4/+4 semitones, soft LFO sweep each delay time, hall reverb 0.8 decay, soft-limit -0.5dB.
script:
# Granular Smear
# Ambient granular texture: 6 parallel delays 25-150ms detune -4/+4 semitones, soft LFO sweep each delay time, hall reverb 0.8 decay, soft-limit -0.5dB.
# a Grain Size: 25 to 150, default 75
# b Detune: 0 to 4, default 2
# c LFO Depth: 0 to 20, default 10
# d LFO Rate: 0.1 to 1.5, default 0.6
# e Verb Decay: 0.6 to 0.95, default 0.8
# f Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 0.75

param a = Grain Size [25.0, 150.0]
param b = Detune [0.0, 4.0]
param c = LFO Depth [0.0, 20.0]
param d = LFO Rate [0.1, 1.5]
param e = Verb Decay [0.6, 0.95]
param f = Mix [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.28
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0
osc2: shape = triangle; freq = d * 1.3; depth = 1.0
osc3: shape = softsquare; freq = d * 0.7; depth = 1.0
pitch1: shift = -b; mix = 0.22
pitch2: shift = b; mix = 0.22
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.3
reverb1: size = 0.85; decay = e; damp = 0.35; mix = 0.35
limit1: ceiling = -0.5; release = 0.15
stage1: y = x * (0.75 + 0.45 * f)
bus g1:
  send: in = 1
  delay1: time = max(8, a * 0.7 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c); feedback = 0.25; mix = 1; damp = 7000
bus g2:
  send: in = 1
  delay2: time = max(8, a * 1.1 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2) * c); feedback = 0.28; mix = 1; damp = 7000
bus g3:
  send: in = 1
  delay3: time = max(8, a * 0.9 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc3) * c); feedback = 0.22; mix = 1; damp = 7000
out: main = 1; g1 = 0.32; g2 = 0.3; g3 = 0.28
